Appended evaluator-directed injection reverses 0-5% of correct verdicts for five models and 17-49% for nine. sources.title: Reading Right, Acting Wrong: Diagnosing Decision Failures of System One Models in Agent Loops
sources.review_note: Abstract only (v1, Oct13). Frozen agent decision states (simulated environments, customer-service policies, tool use, web navigation, coding); each next-action question paired with independent factual probes about the same state. Across seventeen fast systems and a reasoning model, most wrong actions follow correct reading, and more accurate systems have a larger share of such errors. Preliminary version; body not reviewed.

entries.name: Jev / TypeSafe

summary.en: Hosted typed judgments: probabilities over supplied choices, propositions and ordinal rubrics.
summary.zh: 托管的结构化判断服务：对选项、命题与有序评分标准输出分布。

use.en: Managed typed-judgment comparator or frozen semantic-feature generator; compare supervised baselines under the same task and label policy. Keep deterministic business rules in code; separately validate semantic judgments.
use.zh: 可作为托管类型化判断对照或冻结的语义特征提取器；与监督基线比较时统一任务与标签规则。 确定性业务规则由代码执行，语义判断单独验证。

caveat.en: RLCD is vendor-described; the full training recipe is not public. Valid schemas and confidence fields do not establish semantic reliability. Experimental image support is not production readiness; CJK needs its own evaluation. Author deployment stories/smoke checks do not establish a large independently auditable randomized KPI A/B.
caveat.zh: RLCD 的完整训练配方未公开；格式合法与置信度字段不等于语义可靠。 实验图片支持不等于生产成熟，CJK 须另测；作者生产案例／smoke 不构成可独立核验的大规模随机 KPI A/B。

mechanism.en: Proprietary model. Choice/Score confidence summarizes the returned distribution; it is not a separate probability-of-correctness estimate. Noul returns P(yes) with no separate confidence field. Question IDs are not model input; each instruction must be complete. Same-request answers are documented as independent; dependent evidence requires a later request. Question-context independence is not statistical independence of errors.
mechanism.zh: 专有模型。Choice／Score 的 confidence 是返回分布的统计量，并非独立预测的正确概率；Noul 返回 P(yes)，没有单独 confidence 字段。 文档称问题 ID 不送入模型，instructions 须写完整；同请求答案互不作为上下文，依赖新证据的判断需后续请求。 问题上下文互不读取不等于误差在统计上独立。

training.en: Vendor-described RLCD; no customer self-service fine-tuning/LoRA. Request state/instruction customization is not weight adaptation; independent controlled training ablations remain unestablished.
training.zh: 官方称采用 RLCD；不支持客户自助权重微调／LoRA，state／instructions 定制不是权重适配；独立受控训练消融仍未确立。

availability.en: Hosted API; version1.14 dates Oct14, with latest/preview currently aliasing1.14.0. Pin/log the returned version for tuned policies. No public weights verified. Default64k request/32k per question; opt-in262k is explicitly slower/less accurate. Images/Box require experimental opt-in and are below vendor production standards; Box requires1.14. No audio/video. This availability snapshot was reviewed November1; November13 changelog still lists1.14 as the latest release. No media request run here.
availability.zh: 托管 API；1.14 发布于10月14日，latest／preview 当前指向1.14.0，已调策略应固定并记录返回版本。未核公开权重。默认每请求64k／每题32k；实验262k明确更慢／更不准确。图像／Box需实验开关且低于厂商生产标准，Box需1.14；无音频／视频。 上述可用性快照核查于11月1日；11月13日changelog仍列1.14为最新发布。本次未执行媒体请求。

use.en: An inspectable starting point for domain-supervised decision models.
use.zh: 可检查、可微调的领域监督判断实验底座。

caveat.en: Keep trained-family tests separate from transfer. 27B v2 is worse and overconfident on long contracts (CUAD ECE 0.053 versus v1 0.007). Serving capacity and fitted temperature do not guarantee accuracy or calibration on new workloads.
caveat.zh: 须区分训练任务族测试与迁移测试。27B v2 在长合同上退步且过度自信（CUAD ECE 0.053，v1 为 0.007）；可接收长度和拟合温度不保证新任务的准确率或校准。

mechanism.en: Dynamic option readout on a language-model backbone; several model sizes.
mechanism.zh: 在语言模型骨干上动态读出选项分数；提供多个规模。

training.en: 0.8B/4B/9B use LoRA plus a head. 27B v2 fully fine-tunes Qwen3.8-27B, then averages weights 0.85/0.15 with v1. Temperature fitting is distribution-specific; 0.8B/4B use held-out items from trained families. Oct22 adaptation scripts distinguish full question/rubric identity, keep state variants in one split, and reject exact fractional JSON ordinal labels before float rounding. Data-contract fixes, not a weight release.
training.zh: 0.8B／4B／9B 使用 LoRA 与判断头；27B v2 全参数微调 Qwen3.8-27B，再按 0.85／0.15 与 v1 平均权重。温度拟合依赖分布；0.8B／4B 使用训练任务族的保留样本。 10 月 22 日适配脚本按完整问题／rubric 判冲突、同状态变体不跨划分，并在浮点舍入前拒绝真实小数序数标签；这是数据契约修复，不是权重发布。

availability.en: Small releases require the base plus adapter/head; 27B v2 ships about 51 GB of full bf16 weights plus head. Served limit: 65,536 tokens. Author-validated CUAD context: 8,192 for 0.8B/4B/9B, 65,536 for 27B, under the stated 3-pp non-inferiority rule. Current server supports explicit CPU/accelerator selection and isolated fail-closed probes; those probes do not validate every kernel.
availability.zh: 小型号需基座、适配器与判断头；27B v2 发布约 51 GB 的完整 bf16 权重与判断头。服务上限 65,536 token；按作者 CUAD 的 3 个百分点非劣效规则，0.8B／4B／9B 仅验证至 8,192，27B 至 65,536。 当前服务支持明确 CPU／加速器选择及隔离 fail-closed 探测；探测不验证所有内核。

entries.license_note: Kev 1.0 cards declare Apache-2.0 for the released weights/head and listed bases; verify the exact artifact. A family entry has no single weight revision.

scale.en: Released family spans 0.8B, 4B, 9B and 27B; inspect the exact backbone/card.
scale.zh: 公开系列覆盖 0.8B、4B、9B、27B；须核对具体骨干与模型卡。

entries.name: Contrastive Language Models (CLM)

summary.en: Separate state and action representations with learned projection heads on a frozen language-model encoder.
summary.zh: 冻结语言模型编码器，分别表示状态与动作，再用可训练投影头匹配。

use.en: Reusable candidate catalogs, tool selection and domain-trained Best-of-N selection.
use.zh: 适合候选可复用的工具目录、排序及领域 Best-of-N 选择。

caveat.en: Relative ranking cannot detect every all-wrong candidate set. Best-of-N scores include supplied candidates, not autonomous task-solving ability.
caveat.zh: 相对排序不能保证识别“全部候选都错”；Best-of-N 成绩不代表模型独立解题能力。

mechanism.en: Dual encoding permits candidate caching; released base uses frozen Qwen3-8B.
mechanism.zh: 双侧编码允许缓存候选；发布的基础版使用冻结 Qwen3-8B。

training.en: Contrastive InfoNCE with negatives; specialized heads require their own evidence.
training.zh: 含负例的 InfoNCE 对比学习；专项投影头需单独评测。

availability.en: Local code and weights; backbone still runs at inference.
availability.zh: 公开代码与权重；推理仍需运行骨干。

entries.license_note: Base card: Apache-2.0. Reviewed DeepSWE head card: MIT. Do not assign one license to the whole family.

scale.en: 8B base encoder plus learned heads in the reviewed release.
scale.zh: 本版核对的发布使用 8B 骨干及可训练投影头。

entries.name: Bespoke Nimble

summary.en: Open Qwen3.5-9B supervised decision adapter, distinct from the later Nimble hosted v4/v4.1 service.
summary.zh: 开放Qwen3.5-9B监督判断adapter，与后续Nimble托管v4／v4.1服务分别识别。

use.en: A transparent baseline for evidence-sensitive judgments and minimal-edit training examples.
use.zh: 适合证据敏感的判断，也可借鉴最小差异训练样本。

caveat.en: Keep the open 9B model, historical evaluated checkpoints and hosted versions separate. Public benchmarks are author-run and raw runs are incomplete. Minimal-edit examples are a reusable data idea, not production outcome evidence.
caveat.zh: 须区分开放9B、历史被测检查点及托管版本。公开基准由作者运行，完整原始逐次输出不全。最小事实改动法可借鉴，但不是生产效果证明。

mechanism.en: The open 9B model applies LoRA and reads allowed answer-token logits; candidate logits are divided by temperature before softmax, once.
mechanism.zh: 开放9B用LoRA并读允许答案token的logits；候选logits除以温度后做softmax，温度只应用一次。

training.en: Supervised candidate-token CE; minimal-edit evidence pairs are data construction, not an embedding contrastive loss. The reviewed curriculum has 2,676 synthetic training and 324 synthetic evaluation rows; these are not independently adjudicated human benchmark labels.
training.zh: 候选token交叉熵监督；最小事实改动对是数据构造，不是表示层对比损失。已阅课程含2676合成训练／324合成评测行；不等同独立人工基准参考标签。

availability.en: The open 9B model requires the Qwen3.5-9B base plus a PEFT adapter; the pinned card specifies 8k context, 255 options and T=1.0, distinct from original-2676/v2. Public MLX inference does not establish Mac training. Later hosted version claims do not identify an open v4 weight release.
availability.zh: 开放9B需Qwen3.5-9B底座加PEFTadapter；当前卡为8k上下文、255选项、T1.0，与original-2676／v2区分。MLX推理不证明Mac训练；后续托管版本声明不等于开放v4权重。

entries.license_note: Pinned open9B model card declares Apache-2.0; base/dependencies retain their terms. No root LICENSE found in the inspected current GitHub tree; do not infer a blanket source-code license from model metadata.

scale.en: 9B backbone plus adapter; adapter bytes alone are not required memory.
scale.zh: 9B 骨干加适配器；适配器文件大小不等于所需内存。

entries.name: GLiNER2.5-Decide

summary.en: Schema-conditioned local classification with runtime labels and multiple decision heads.
summary.zh: 通过运行时标签与多个判断头实现模式条件化的本地分类。

use.en: Compact operational classification; inspect the runtime for supported cross-field constraints.
use.zh: 适合轻量业务分类；跨字段约束需核对具体运行库支持。

caveat.en: This review inspected the 1B card, which cross-reports 340M results. Dataset audit is incomplete; JevK5 in that table is not TypeSafe Jev.
caveat.zh: 本版核对的是 1B 模型卡，其中交叉报告 340M 成绩；数据集审计未完成，表中 JevK5 不是 TypeSafe Jev。

mechanism.en: Encoder-style classification; single-label and multilabel outputs.
mechanism.zh: 编码器式分类；支持单标签与多标签输出。

training.en: Treat checkpoint-specific training details as documented, not inferred from sibling models. Oct20 runtime fixes distributed gradient synchronization; audit prior multi-GPU adaptation runs. Published checkpoint exposure to this defect is unknown; no inferred retraining or gain.
training.zh: 训练细节按具体检查点文档记录，不从同系列模型推断。 10 月 20 日运行库修复多卡梯度同步，既有分布式适配运行应核查；公开检查点是否受影响未知，不推断已重训或性能提升。

availability.en: Published checkpoints; current runtime supports Transformers 5 and schema-extraction loading. Match runtime, checkpoint config and classify_text examples; unchanged LFS weight identity across the watched revisions.
availability.zh: 公开检查点；当前运行库支持 Transformers 5 与 schema-extraction 加载。须匹配运行库、检查点配置及 classify_text 示例；所监测两版本的 LFS 权重标识相同。

entries.license_note: Reviewed 1B card declares Apache-2.0; other checkpoints need separate checks.

scale.en: 1B card directly reviewed; 340M and 287M sibling results/links are cross-reported there.
scale.zh: 直接核对 1B 卡；340M 与 287M 同系列资料由该卡交叉报告。

entries.name: GLiClass (v4 family; v4.1 Edge metadata only)

summary.en: Label-conditioned classification family: v4 adds decoder-KV/label scoring and multimodal Qwen variants; v4.1 Edge is an incompletely documented artifact.
summary.zh: 标签条件分类系列：v4有decoder-KV／label评分及多模态Qwen变体；v4.1 Edge目前属于文档不完整的产物。

use.en: Dynamic intent/label classification comparator, choosing single-label or multilabel semantics and measuring task-specific calibration.
use.zh: 作为动态意图／标签分类对照，先选单标签或多标签语义，再量具体任务的校准。

caveat.en: Architecture, label cardinality and calibrator differ by release. Do not inherit v4 license/quality/training claims into undocumented v4.1; a high label score is not a certified correctness probability or enterprise routing guarantee.
caveat.zh: 不同发布物的架构、标签数及calibrator不同；不得将v4许可／质量／训练声明继承给缺文档v4.1，高label分数不是认证正确概率或企业路由保证。

mechanism.en: In reviewed v4 decoder-KV variants, the backbone encodes input evidence, transient label tokens read its cache, and a label scorer/refinement cell produces scores without text generation. Single-label softmax and multilabel scores are different contracts; inspect the chosen architecture.
mechanism.zh: 所阅v4 decoder-KV变体先编码输入证据，再由临时label token读缓存，label评分／迭代模块输出分数，不生成文本。单标签softmax与多标签分数的合同不同，须核具体架构。

training.en: The repository provides supervised training entry points; reviewed v4 cards describe decision-mixture training and, for calibrated releases, a fitted per-pair calibrator. The exact released-v4 full pipeline and all data were not independently replayed. Do not infer a usable v4.1 recipe from the older family trainer.
training.zh: 仓库提供监督训练入口；所阅v4卡描述判断数据混合训练，带校准器的发布物另拟合逐对calibrator。未独立重放精确v4完整流程和所有数据，也不能从旧family trainer推定v4.1已有可用配方。

availability.en: Public v4 cards and weights exist. v4 Edge includes a calibrator; the reviewed 2B card explicitly ships without one and warns of saturated raw scores. November 9 v4.1 Edge has model/config/tokenizer files but no inspected README/LICENSE/cardData. No verified M5 training result or v4.1 deployment contract.
availability.zh: v4模型卡及权重公开；v4 Edge带calibrator，所阅2B卡明确未带并提醒raw分数趋0／1。11月9日v4.1 Edge有model／config／tokenizer，但所查无README／LICENSE／cardData；没有已验证M5训练结果或v4.1部署合同。

entries.license_note: Reviewed v4 cards/repository declare Apache-2.0; v4.1 Edge lacks inspected license metadata/files and remains unresolved. Verify each model/base/data artifact separately.

scale.en: Checkpoint-specific: v4 Edge 0.4B uses DeBERTa; v4 Qwen-based 2B / 9B / 27B variants have separate identities. No single family size or calibration claim.
scale.zh: 依检查点而定：v4 Edge0.4B用DeBERTa，v4 Qwen系2B／9B／27B分别固定身份，不为整族指定单一规模或校准结论。

entries.name: jevos (current v5; historical v2)

summary.en: Local CPU typed decisions in a Jev-shaped API: v5 adds documented choice and early score support alongside yes/no, with OpenVINO INT8 and GGUF assets.
summary.zh: 本地CPU类型化判断，采用Jev形状的API：v5文档在是非之外加入choice和早期score支持，发布OpenVINO INT8及GGUF产物。

use.en: A CPU inference comparator for short policy/triage decisions; validate each supported type and the exact released artifact before considering adaptation.
use.zh: 作为短规则／分流判断的CPU推理对照；考虑适配前，先验证各题型与精确发布产物。

caveat.en: Do not apply old v2 noul-only/422/ignored-criteria descriptions to v5. Wire-format compatibility does not establish semantic equivalence; score support is labeled early. Current parameter lineage, calibrated risk and a usable enterprise fine-tuning path remain unknown.
caveat.zh: 不可把旧v2仅noul／422／忽略criteria的描述套给v5。接口形状兼容不等于语义等价，score仍标为早期支持；当前参数谱系、校准风险及可用企业续训链仍未知。

mechanism.en: Current v5 documentation returns per-answer probabilities and expected score levels without free-form output; several questions share an input request. The earlier audited fixed binary-token readout belongs to an older version, not a verified complete v5 implementation audit.
mechanism.zh: 当前v5文档返回候选概率和期望评分，不输出自由文本；同输入可带多个问题。此前核读的固定二元token读出属于旧版，不能冒称已完整审计v5内部实现。

training.en: A complete training recipe, dataset and base-checkpoint lineage remain unestablished. The seven task sets described in the v5 README helped select the released checkpoint, so they are development evidence rather than an untouched independent test.
training.zh: 完整训练配方、数据及base谱系仍未建立；v5 README所列七组任务参与发布检查点选择，属于开发证据，不是未触及的独立测试。

availability.en: GitHub v5 release published October 16 with Linux, Windows and macOS-arm64 binaries, OpenVINO INT8 and q4/q8 GGUF plus SHA256SUMS. HF main has a different earlier timestamp; equality to the GitHub v5 package is not authenticated. Asset metadata and Mac binary existence are not a local weight hash or M5 training result.
availability.zh: GitHub v5于10月16日发布Linux／Windows／macOS-arm64程序、OpenVINO INT8及q4／q8 GGUF和SHA256SUMS。HF main时间较早，尚未认证其与GitHub v5包相同；asset元数据及Mac程序存在不等于本地权重hash或M5训练结果。

entries.license_note: Repository LICENSE is MIT and the inspected HF metadata declares MIT; exact GitHub v5 weight/base provenance and any inherited terms are not fully authenticated here.

scale.en: Earlier documentation described 1B; an independently checked current-v5 tensor parameter count and exact base identity were not established.
scale.zh: 早期资料称1B；本轮未独立核算当前v5张量参数量，也未建立精确base身份。

entries.name: Clef / Clef-Flash / Clef-Omni

summary.en: Cloudflare typed-decision family: dense Clef/Flash and October 9 Clef-Omni use joint schema scoring; Clairic is a separate extraction family.
summary.zh: Cloudflare类型化判断系列：稠密Clef／Flash及10月9日Clef-Omni用联合schema评分；Clairic是独立提取系列。

use.en: Compare bounded judgments using required text/image/audio/video evidence, at matched workload risk and full-system cost.
use.zh: 按任务所需文本／图像／音频／视频证据，在相同风险与完整系统成本下比较有界判断。

caveat.en: Vendor task-specific benchmarks and API compatibility do not certify business risk. Keep Omni, dense releases and adjacent Clairic extraction distinct. Public weights do not prove complete original-data replay, a customer-training service contract, or local Mac training feasibility.
caveat.zh: 厂商分任务基准及API兼容不认证业务风险。Omni、稠密发布物及邻接Clairic提取须分别识别；公开权重不证明完整原始数据重放、客户训练服务合同或Mac本地训练可行。

mechanism.en: A joint transformer schema head routes state evidence and scores allowed options without free-form text generation. Omni retains visual/audio encoders, while unused speech-output modules are not loaded. Clairic extraction generation must not be attributed to these decision releases.
mechanism.zh: 联合Transformer schema头路由state证据并给允许选项评分，不生成自由文本；Omni保留视觉／音频编码器，不加载未用的语音输出模块。不可将Clairic提取生成机制归入这些判断发布物。

training.en: The original dense Clef report describes rank 256 LoRA plus routing head, smoothed CE, Brier and secondary RLCD on internal synthetic data; full data/recipe not independently audited. Do not silently assign that exact recipe to Omni. The MersivMedia community adaptation remains experimental, without a verified real-weight multimodal run/export or RLCD reproduction. No complete Omni enterprise fine-tuning package was established in this refresh.
training.zh: 原稠密Clef报告描述rank256 LoRA加routing head、平滑CE、Brier与辅助RLCD，数据为内部合成；完整数据／配方未经独立审计，不可默认为Omni也用完全相同配方。MersivMedia社区适配仍为实验实现，未验证真实权重多模态训练／导出或RLCD复现。本轮未建立完整Omni企业微调包。

availability.en: Public custom HF runtimes and Workers AI. Omni binary package dates to October 9; later metadata are evaluations. October 9 Clef serving speedups and Flash hosted context 64k→24k did not change dense weights. Local defaults, hosted limits and media/truncation differ. Existing MLX-VLM inference support is not generic SFT-head training support; no M5 training verified.
availability.zh: 公开定制HF运行库及Workers AI；Omni binary包始于10月9日，后续metadata为评测。10月9日Clef服务提速及Flash托管context64k→24k未改变稠密权重。本地默认、托管上限、媒体与截断合同不同；已有MLX-VLM推理支持不等于通用SFT-head训练，未验证M5训练。

entries.license_note: Reviewed dense and Omni cards declare Apache-2.0; exact bases, datasets, runtime notices and any training-service terms require separate checks.

scale.en: Clef 27B Qwen3.8, Flash 9B Qwen3.5, and Omni Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct thinker. Omni card reports about 64 GB BF16 on H200; active MoE size does not imply 48 GB training fit.
scale.zh: Clef27B基于Qwen3.8，Flash9B基于Qwen3.5，Omni基于Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct thinker。Omni卡示例BF16约64GB／H200，MoE激活规模不意味着48GB能训练。

entries.name: Strands Decider (v1 pointer / v2 code readout)

summary.en: Qwen / Gemma decision family: v1 adapter-and-pointer releases and November 17 Gemma 4 E2B v2 merged code-readout release have different training and serving contracts.
summary.zh: Qwen／Gemma判断系列：v1为adapter与pointer发布物，11月17日Gemma4 E2B v2为合并权重与答码读出；训练及服务合同不同。

use.en: Compare v1 and v2 on the same bounded text decisions; audit the actual domain-training starting point and exported inference path before selecting a recipe.
use.zh: 在相同有界文本判断上比较v1与v2；选配方前核对领域训练从何种权重开始及导出后的推理路径。

caveat.en: Do not transfer v1 pointer/soup/KL or missing-image results to v2. v2 was trained on text; inherited image input is not image-adaptation evidence. Author public benchmarks and calibrated temperature do not certify enterprise risk. Legacy E07/E08/E11 and their missing-data/development-selection limitations remain dated records.
caveat.zh: 不可将v1的pointer／soup／KL或缺图结果直接套给v2。v2仅用文本训练，继承图片输入不等于图像适配证据。作者公共基准及拟合温度不认证企业风险；E07／E08／E11及其缺数据、开发选择限制保留为带日期记录。

mechanism.en: v1 replaces the LM head with a dynamic pointer head. v2 E2B trains a 255-code LM-row readout with strands-chat and prefix_bidir: state is shared, question branches are isolated, and all Gemma layers use the stated full-prompt mask, including normally sliding-window layers. No free-text generation.
mechanism.zh: v1以动态pointer头替代LM头；v2 E2B用255答码LM-row读出、strands-chat及prefix_bidir：共享state，各题分支隔离；按其专用mask处理全部Gemma层，包括通常的滑窗层。不生成自由文本。

training.en: v1 Qwen / Gemma recipes and three-seed adapter/head soups remain historical and have missing inputs. Current source also publishes v2 from-base supervised recipes: E2B rank 64 / alpha 128 LoRA plus token readout, prefix_bidir and a typed-row converter. Original v2 training/dev data are absent; the converter drops images and missing instructions. Export merges adapters into base BF16 shards and saves readout.safetensors plus decision_config.json. The trainer supports token-readout training but rejects its frozen-KL anchor option.
training.zh: v1的Qwen／Gemma配方与三种子adapter／head平均保留为历史，部分输入缺失。当前源码也公开v2从原始底座开始的监督配方：E2B为rank64／alpha128 LoRA加token readout、prefix_bidir及typed-row转换；原v2训练／开发数据未公开，转换器丢弃图片及缺instructions行。导出将adapter合入base BF16 shards，另存readout.safetensors和decision_config.json；trainer支持token-readout训练，但拒绝其frozen-KL选项。

availability.en: v1 trained adapter/head checkpoints can use init_from and then recalibrate. Released v2 is a merged decision checkpoint without the training config/adapter layout expected by that init_from loader; direct domain continuation from its HF ID is not established. Public v2 recipes can train on supplied text rows from the original base, or continue a retained unmerged training checkpoint. v2 MPS/CPU support on the card is inference; training selects CUDA else CPU and documents Linux/WSL NVIDIA. No M5 training run or generic MLX calibration support verified.
availability.zh: v1已训adapter／head检查点可用init_from并重新校准；发布v2为合并decision检查点，不含该init_from loader要求的训练config／adapter布局，尚未建立直接从其HF ID领域续训的路径。公开v2配方可从原始底座用自备文本训练，或继续保留的未合并训练检查点。卡片的MPS／CPU支持指推理；训练器选择CUDA否则CPU，文档以Linux／WSL NVIDIA为环境，未验证M5训练或通用MLX校准。

entries.license_note: Reviewed v1 adapter/head and v2 model/code declare Apache-2.0; v1 loads a separate base, v2 ships merged base plus readout. Check exact base/data terms; no M5 or original-data replay claim.

scale.en: v1 spans Qwen3.5 2B and Gemma 4 E2B/E4B/12B/26B-A4B. Released v2 E2B is 2.3B effective and 5.1B with embeddings, about 10.3 GB BF16; active size is not resident memory.
scale.zh: v1覆盖Qwen3.5 2B及Gemma4 E2B／E4B／12B／26B-A4B。已发布v2 E2B为2.3B有效参数、含embedding共5.1B，BF16约10.3GB；激活规模不等于驻留内存。

summary.en: Few-shot sentence-transformer adaptation followed by a classification head.
summary.zh: 少样本句向量适配，再训练分类头。

use.en: Fixed-label tasks with labeled examples.
use.zh: 有标注数据的固定标签任务。

caveat.en: Not an arbitrary typed-question API.

entries.name: Perplexity Decider (current v1.3; archival v1 / v1.1 / v1.2)

summary.en: v1.3 typed-decision and optional span-location family; 27B Qwen3.8 and distilled Flash 4B Qwen3.5, with distinct earlier versions.
summary.zh: v1.3类型化判断及可选span定位系列；27B Qwen3.8与蒸馏Flash 4B Qwen3.5，早期版本分别保留。

use.en: A self-hosted comparator for text/image judgments after task-specific validation.
use.zh: 经具体任务验证后，作为文本／图像判读的自部署对照。

caveat.en: Version, mode, grouping, images and backend alter the inference contract. v1.2 historical results cannot be relabeled v1.3. Neither near-identical fast-path choices nor a fitted temperature establish new-domain quality, production risk or Mac training.

mechanism.en: Default separate encodes each state/images/question independently; isolated uses shared state with a different attention contract. A 255-code readout replaces full-vocabulary generation. Locate uses a separate optional span adapter; mixed Locate/decisions require two passes.
mechanism.zh: 默认separate逐题独立编码state／images／question；isolated共享状态且attention合同不同。255答码readout不生成完整词表文本。Locate另用可选span adapter；与判断混合需两次pass。

training.en: v1.3 saved configs disclose CE for 27B and teacher-distribution distillation for Flash, frozen readouts. Temperatures 1.2263882168038833 / 1.3302962111834522 are v1.3-specific. Complete original training data/replay not verified. Preserve v1.2 training and comparisons in its dated records.

availability.en: November 19 HF metadata public/ungated despite residual private-repository wording; tensors not downloaded. Saved image cap 1.6 MP. scale.zh: 27B Qwen3.8 与 Flash 4B Qwen3.5；头维度、校准器分别匹配。

entries.name: OpenAI Decisions API / GPT-6 Luna

summary.en: GA typed-judgment API for text and images.
summary.zh: 面向文本／图像的GA类型化判断API。

use.en: Managed classification, routing and ordinal scoring.
use.zh: 托管分类、路由与有序评分。

caveat.en: Refusal is a separate answer variant, not calibrated abstention. Confidence needs target-task validation; training and serving identity are undisclosed here.

training.en: No public weights or Decisions-specific customer tuning entry verified; generic model fine-tuning support is not this product contract.
training.zh: 未核公开权重或Decisions专属客户调优入口；通用模型微调支持不自动成为本产品合同。

summary.zh: 11月11日发布的托管模型，支持文本、图像、音频、视频和PDF判断，在共享输入上隔离各问题。

use.en: Compare multimodal triage, media policy checks and routing at fixed evidence, risk and complete cost.

caveat.en: Calibration, speed and internal deployments are vendor-reported. Confidence is top-outcome probability, not independent reliability evidence. Safety blocks return HTTP400; no cache or Batch API.

training.zh: 专有模型；未取得独立审计的训练混合、校准划分或污染分析。
