entries.name: Nace Drex v1.5 / v2.0 / Max v1

summary.en: Drex family: text pointer-head v1.5/v2.0 and dense 27B multimodal Max v1 with a fixed 255-code readout.
summary.zh: Drex 系列：文本 pointer-head v1.5／v2.0，加上独立 255-code 读出的多模态 dense 27B Max v1。

use.en: Compare local text/JSON decisions and Max CUDA image judgments; match precision, readout, evidence and context before comparing releases.
use.zh: 比较本地文本／JSON 与 Max CUDA 图像判断；跨版本比较须匹配精度、读出、证据和上下文。

caveat.en: v1.5 uses benchmark training splits; its results are not unseen-domain zero-shot. Public Index 0.3.1 leaders fall inside its tie band. Small runner checks do not establish broad parity. v2.0 JevBench author counts trail Jev 1.13.0 by two items (E32); this is not a significance result or a universal win. Current snapshot is not proven identical to evaluated weights. Max public-only Index results are not private text Full0.4; retain the failed native probability-parity gate, not just stable categorical picks. Max RLAF stage gains (E45) lack equal-extra-compute continued-SFT and training-seed controls; they do not erase the earlier serving-parity limits.
caveat.zh: v1.5 使用基准训练划分，其结果不能视为未知领域零样本；公开 Index 0.3.1 前列处于平局带内，小规模运行器核对不证明普遍等价。 v2.0 作者 JevBench 计数比 Jev 1.13.0 少两题（E32），不作显著性或普遍胜出结论；当前 snapshot 与实测权重未建立同一性。 Max 仅公共 Index 结果不能当作私有文本 Full0.4；须保留原生路径概率等价未通过，不能只看选项未翻转。 Max RLAF阶段正结果（E45）缺等新增算力的继续SFT与训练种子控制，也不能抹去旧服务路径的概率等价限制。

scale.en: v1.5 approximately 9B; v2.0 author describes 35B total/~3B active, 256 experts/8 active. Active size is not resident weight memory; tensors not independently counted. Max v1 is nominal dense27B; a runtime docstring identifies Qwen3.8-27B, while release prose omits the base name. No independent tensor count.
scale.zh: v1.5 约 9B；v2.0 作者称总量 35B／激活约 3B，256 专家中激活 8 个。激活规模不等于驻留权重内存，未独立统计张量。 Max v1 名义 dense27B；运行库 docstring 称 Qwen3.8-27B，发布正文未列基座名，未独立统计张量。

mechanism.en: Pointer head scores supplied noul/choice/score options without generation, per question. v2.0 runtime extracts Qwen3_5Moe language_model and drops vision; hybrid questions are independent causal rows. Fork runtimes can share state prefixes. Max differs: last-state biasless255-code head, noncausal full-attention and causal linear layers, a complete independent row per question; no shared state cache.
mechanism.zh: pointer head 每题对给定 noul／choice／score 候选评分而不生成。v2.0 运行时提取 Qwen3_5Moe language_model 并舍弃视觉，混合骨干的各题为独立因果 row；分支运行库可共享状态前缀。 Max 不同：最后状态经无偏置255-code头，full-attention双向而线性层因果；每题完整独立行，无共享状态缓存。

training.en: v1.5 uses benchmark training splits plus procedural data. The November 9 v2 paper describes staged supervision, adjusted feedback, v2.0 specialization and Max vision tuning. Pointer RLAF directly differentiates corrected-target proper losses; Max uses finite-action verified/judge reward with reference KL. These versions have different recipes. Full raw training/calibration data, complete RLAF trainer and identity of every evaluated tensor remain unverified; do not transfer one release recipe or temperature to another.
training.zh: v1.5使用基准训练划分加程序数据。11月9日论文v2补充阶段监督、修正反馈、v2.0专项及Max视觉训练；pointer RLAF直接求修正目标的proper loss梯度，Max为有限动作verified／judge奖励加参考KL，各版配方不同。原始训练／校准数据、完整RLAF训练器与全部被测张量身份仍未核实，不能移植某一版配方或温度。

availability.en: Python CUDA and Nace llama.cpp/Ollama forks; default state-plus-one-question limit 16384, configurable maximum 131072. v2.0 HF snapshot/card/config plus 16 shard and head LFS identities reviewed; no tensors downloaded or parity tested. Base vision packaging does not establish image input support. Oct23 Q4_K_M Apple path adds Kapitsa v0.2.15 shared-state branches/cache; defaults separately cap state, branch, packed request and sequence at 16384. Hardware-fit/short-ticket medians do not establish quantized decision quality, calibration or 131072-context accuracy. Max CUDA supports images; Mac GGUF/MLX/Kapitsa is text-only. Max default16384/configured262144 is not validated long-context quality. Kapitsa max probability drift0.0329 exceeds its0.02 parity gate despite no flips; long-row/32k reference checks remain unrun. A21-field short Q4 check on48GB is not broad hardware/calibration validation.
availability.zh: Python CUDA 及 Nace llama.cpp／Ollama 分支；状态加一题默认上限 16384、可配置最大 131072。已核 v2.0 HF snapshot／卡／配置、16 分片及 head 的 LFS 标识，未下载张量或测试等价；基座视觉包装不证明支持图像输入。 10 月 23 日 Q4_K_M 苹果路径新增 Kapitsa v0.2.15 共享状态分支／缓存；状态、分支、整包及序列各默认限 16384。硬件可装载／短工单中位延迟不证明量化决策质量、校准或 131072 长度准确率。 Max CUDA 支持图像；Mac GGUF／MLX／Kapitsa 仅文本。Max 默认16384／配置262144不证明长上下文质量。Kapitsa 最大概率漂移0.0329超过0.02等价门槛，虽无答案翻转仍未通过；长行／32k参考核验未跑。48GB上的21字段短Q4检查不等于普遍硬件／校准验收。

entries.license_note: Code Apache-2.0; weights use modified Nace.AI Open RAIL-M with commercial thresholds, competitor exclusions and use restrictions. Public access does not imply unrestricted open source.

entries.name: vLLM-SR D3 / Turbo / Ultra / D3.1-nano

summary.en: Multimodal typed-decision family with distinct classic per-question, Turbo/Ultra shared-state and November 12 D3.1-nano releases.
summary.zh: 多模态类型化判断系列，经典逐题、Turbo／Ultra共享state及11月12日D3.1-nano发布物须分别识别。

use.en: Matched text/image/video decision comparisons, with small D3.1-nano as a separate capability candidate and Ultra as a larger reference; verify adaptation separately.
use.zh: 固定文本／图像／视频判断合同对比；将小型D3.1-nano作为独立能力候选、Ultra作为大模型参照，适配可行性另验。

caveat.en: Keep official private Full, public-suite and author SR-Text/SR-Box results separate. D3.1-nano reported public score uses two choice orders averaged; ordinary runtime reads one order, and its image/video quality is unevaluated. CoreML/quantized ports and security/cache fixes are not new native training. API aliases do not freeze model identity; historical E12–E16/E21–E23 protocols remain unchanged.
caveat.zh: 官方private Full、public suite及作者SR-Text／SR-Box结果分别记录。D3.1-nano报告的公共分数平均两种choice顺序，普通运行库只读一种；该版本图像／视频质量未评测。CoreML／量化端口及安全／cache修复不等于新的native训练；API别名不固定模型身份，E12–E16／E21–E23历史协议不变。

scale.en: Classic card counts range from 0.59B edge to 26.09B d3 including vision. Ultra is 26.09B including 0.46B vision; D3.1-nano is 2.21B including 0.33B vision, based on Qwen3.5-2B. Nominal size and serving memory differ.
scale.zh: 经典卡片参数量含视觉，从edge 0.59B到d3 26.09B。Ultra为26.09B（视觉0.46B）；D3.1-nano基于Qwen3.5-2B，共2.21B（视觉0.33B）。名义规模不同于服务内存。

mechanism.en: Classic D3 and D3.1-nano use an independent forward pass per question despite one HTTP call; candidate-code readouts normalize allowed options. Turbo/Ultra reuse state for question branches. Full-attention layers and causal DeltaNet behavior require the release runtime. Confidence fields/backend semantics are not interchangeable correctness probabilities; Ultra adds Box/Track, which require their own presence and localization checks.
mechanism.zh: 经典D3及D3.1-nano即使一次HTTP调用也逐题独立前向，以答码读出归一化允许选项；Turbo／Ultra为问题分支复用state。Full-attention与因果DeltaNet行为须匹配发布运行库。不同后端confidence不能当作同一正确概率；Ultra另有Box／Track，须分别验目标存在及定位。

training.en: Original full training mixture/recipe and overlap/calibration audits remain unestablished. Prior classic/Turbo wrapper audits found inference-only restrictions; those are not proof about every external trainer. The separate Vis Decisions path provides text-only full/LoRA adaptation and strips vision, not original or multimodal D3 training reproduction. This refresh establishes new release identities, not an audited Ultra/D3.1-nano enterprise fine-tuning workflow.
training.zh: 原始完整训练混合、配方及重叠／校准审计仍未确立。既有经典／Turbo封装审查发现仅推理限制，但这不能否定所有外部训练器。独立Vis Decisions提供去视觉的文本full／LoRA适配，不是原始或多模态D3训练复现。本轮确认新发布身份，未建立已审计的Ultra／D3.1-nano企业续训链。

availability.en: Ultra was released October 26; November 17 cache/card edits are runtime/metadata. D3.1-nano weights were uploaded November 12; later manifest/card edits are not retraining. Existing six native models and Turbo binary identities match the compared pins; a separate CoreML repo added edge conversion/MLX binaries on October 14. Custom Transformers/Router/native-vLLM support differs by release and build; historical integration limits are not current universal guarantees. No weights downloaded or M5 training verified.
availability.zh: Ultra于10月26日发布，11月17日cache／card改动属运行库及元数据；D3.1-nano权重11月12日上传，后续manifest／card不是重训。既有六个native模型及Turbo与对比pin的binary身份相同；另一个CoreML仓10月14日新增edge转换／MLX binary。定制Transformers／Router／原生vLLM能力依发布物和build不同，历史集成限制不是当前通用保证；未下载权重或验证M5训练。

entries.license_note: Reviewed classic/Turbo and new Ultra/D3.1-nano cards declare Apache-2.0; check exact base/runtime notices. Binary metadata comparison is not local tensor-byte verification or full training-data availability.

summary.en: Apple deployment resource with native Swift managers and Python-assisted Core ML bridges, including Decision 3.0.
summary.zh: Apple 部署资源，含原生 Swift manager 与 Python 辅助 Core ML bridge，支持 Decision 3.0 等。

use.en: Test a local deployment against its upstream renderer, probabilities, failure handling and task labels.
use.zh: 把本地部署与上游 renderer、概率、失败处理和任务标签逐项核对。

caveat.en: Conversion parity and smoke tests are not quality guarantees. Match length buckets, precision, tokenizer, calibrator and media path; bridge calls queue serially and timeouts close the session. Automatic downloads/environment setup are documented, not run here.
caveat.zh: 转换等价和 smoke test 不保证质量；须匹配长度 bucket、精度、tokenizer、校准器与媒体路径。bridge 调用串行排队，超时会关闭 session；文档中的自动下载／环境安装本轮未运行。

entries.name: Intern-Decision

summary.en: Qwen3.5 multimodal 0.8B/2B/4B family; multiple typed fields scored from one causal masked assistant skeleton.
summary.zh: Qwen3.5 多模态 0.8B／2B／4B 系列，在一个因果 masked assistant skeleton 中评分多个类型化字段。

use.en: Compare multi-field cost and field/order sensitivity against per-question models; test image-grounded judgments.
use.zh: 与每题独立模型比较多字段成本和字段／顺序敏感性，测试基于图像证据的判断。

caveat.en: Private training/calibration records are absent. A 96-case distribution pilot is diagnostic; size/backend-specific temperature and max(P) confidence are not portable business risk guarantees. Paper seven-suite accuracy concerns text tasks; visual trajectories are qualitative. Public Jevbench informed development; matched-data ablations and a matched D3 multimodal comparison are absent from the reviewed evidence.
caveat.zh: 原始训练／校准记录私有；96-case 分布试验只作诊断。型号／后端专属温度与 max(P) confidence 不能直接保证业务风险。 论文七套准确率针对文本任务，视觉轨迹为定性演示；公开 Jevbench 参与开发，已阅证据缺同数据消融及同条件 D3 多模态对照。

scale.en: 0.8B, 2B and 4B nominal Qwen3.5 sizes; independently inspected cards, no local tensor count.
scale.zh: 0.8B、2B、4B 为 Qwen3.5 名义规模；分别核对模型卡，未本地统计张量。

mechanism.en: Reads candidate-token logits immediately before each `<decision>` placeholder in one causal pass; up to 16 fields / 62 options, no free-text generation. Fields share the schema sequence, so order/context invariance needs testing. Confidence=max(P), unlike Jev distribution summaries.
mechanism.zh: 一次因果前向，从每个 `<decision>` 前一位置读取候选 token logits；最多 16 字段／62 选项，不生成自由文本。字段共享 schema 序列，须验证顺序／上下文不变性；confidence=max(P)，不同于 Jev 的分布统计量。

training.en: Decision-tuned language backbone; frozen vision tower/projector. Cards report NLL temperature fitting on 1728 calibration and 1693 separate validation cases: 0.8B T=2.747760550703, 2B T=2.100509348278, 4B T=1.99241824. Private original records and full data construction remain unavailable. Inspected XTuner configuration trains full language parameters with masked full-vocabulary answer-token CE, not LoRA; gold symbols remain labels, while the input retains placeholders. Paper v1 reports 17880 training samples / 23500 decisions, including 5500 image-bearing samples, for full language-backbone tuning with vision/projector frozen. This is not LoRA effectiveness evidence or verification that the full raw training data are public. Oct26 deeper audit confirms Sep26 code, not a new release: MEDIA_ROOT selects visual tokenization; actual UniversalDataset passes pixels/grid through the collator to frozen visual-feature injection. Missing image grids reject. Final HF saving/tensor-audit tools exist, but were not run.
training.zh: 微调语言骨干，冻结视觉 tower／projector。卡片称用 1728 校准及 1693 独立验证样本按 NLL 拟合温度：0.8B 为 2.747760550703、2B 为 2.100509348278、4B 为 1.99241824；原始私有记录及完整数据构建未公开。已审阅 XTuner 配置以 masked 完整词表 answer-token CE 训练语言全参数，并非 LoRA；金标答码只在 labels，输入保持占位符。 论文 v1 称有 17880 条训练样本／23500 个决策，其中 5500 条带图；训练语言骨干、冻结视觉塔／projector。它不是 LoRA 效果证据，也不代表已核实完整原始训练数据公开。 10 月 26 日深化核验的是 9 月 26 日源码而非新发布：MEDIA_ROOT 选择视觉分词，实际 UniversalDataset 经 collator 把 pixels／grid 送入冻结视觉特征注入；缺 grid 拒绝。存在最终 HF 保存／张量审计工具，本次未执行。

availability.en: Public HF weights, own inference.py and repository HF/XTuner paths. HF card default 8192 tokens rejects overlength, up to 8 images. Core ML 0.8B port in FluidUse is text-only and uses smaller fixed buckets; it does not inherit HF image/context support.
availability.zh: 公开 HF 权重、专属 inference.py 及仓库 HF／XTuner 路径。HF 卡默认 8192 token、超长拒绝，最多 8 图；FluidUse 的 Core ML 0.8B 仅文本、较小固定 bucket，不能继承 HF 的图像／上下文支持。

entries.license_note: Three inspected cards declare Apache-2.0 and retained Qwen notices. Check evaluation dataset licenses separately; original training/private calibration records are not released. Root repository Apache-2.0 LICENSE was already present at the September 29 commit; the November 20 check is a correction of contrary claims, not a new license grant.

entries.name: Verdict / OpenJev
entries.weight_revision: HF repository 8af2496eb63c7fa66d7d234e1f62629380030eb4 (source pin; tensor bytes not locally verified)

summary.en: 151M ModernBERT/GLiClass candidate classifier with an explicit insufficient-evidence option and per-K calibration.
summary.zh: 151M ModernBERT／GLiClass 候选分类器，含显式证据不足选项及 per-K 校准。

use.en: Compact intent classification and missing-option tests; compare native serving probabilities with the exact evaluation renderer/calibrator.
use.zh: 轻量意图分类与缺少正确选项测试；核对实际服务概率和评测 renderer／校准器。

caveat.en: Author tests show abstention collapsing under hard negatives and synonym wording. Converter reports shipped serving calibration differs substantially from the held-out evaluation; no domain-independent abstention guarantee.
caveat.zh: 作者测试显示 hard negative 和同义改写下拒答崩塌；转换者报告实际服务校准与保留集评测明显不同，不能保证跨域拒答可靠性。

scale.en: 151378177 parameters reported; up to 25 logits = 24 substantive candidates plus abstention.
scale.zh: 报告 151378177 参数；最多 25 logits，即 24 个实质候选加拒答项。

mechanism.en: Encoder scores candidates including __insufficient_evidence__, without text generation. Engine renders hypothesis-style descriptions and applies candidate-count temperatures; choosing abstention is a trained candidate decision, not a risk bound.
mechanism.zh: 编码器评分包括 __insufficient_evidence__ 的候选，不生成文本。Engine 使用 hypothesis-style 描述及候选数对应温度；拒答是学习到的候选判断，并非风险上界。

training.en: Author describes CE+Brier post-training with temperature scaling. Shipped per-K/global calibration differs from the single T fitted by the held-out evaluator; original full training provenance and all open-domain fitting splits not independently audited.
training.zh: 作者称使用 CE+Brier 后训练与温度校准；发布的 per-K／全局校准不同于保留集评测拟合的单温度。完整原始训练来源及所有开放域拟合划分未独立审计。

availability.en: Public HF weights/ONNX and Python/WebGPU/WASM paths; 512-token serving budget. Separate Core ML FP16 L128/L512 conversion with full rendered-request limits; LUT8 package failed conversion acceptance and is not validated.
availability.zh: 公开 HF 权重／ONNX 及 Python／WebGPU／WASM 路径，服务预算 512 token。独立 Core ML FP16 L128／L512 转换须遵守完整请求长度；LUT8 未通过转换验收，不属于已验证包。

entries.license_note: Pinned model card and repository declare Apache-2.0; base and dataset terms remain separate. An OpenJev name denotes this independent project, not an official TypeSafe release.

summary.en: Original-evaluator comparison of Jev and supervised text/TF-IDF models on earnings, 8-K labels and SEC follow-up.
summary.zh: 原评测者比较 Jev 与监督文本／TF-IDF 模型，分别测试财报变化、8-K 标签和 SEC 后续问询。

use.en: Test task/label alignment and supervised baselines before selecting typed judgments.
use.zh: 先核任务／标签对齐和监督基线，再选择类型化判断。

caveat.en: Vendor API support; historical selected populations, hindsight screening, post-hoc prompts and split limitations. No universal tree-versus-Jev winner or investment-return claim.
caveat.zh: 厂商提供 API；历史筛选样本含回顾检查、事后提示和划分限制，不能宣布树模型／Jev 通用胜负或投资收益。

summary.en: LLM-proposed questions and Jev judgments turn text into features for a supervised CatBoost predictor.
summary.zh: LLM 提议问题，Jev 将文本转成语义特征，再由监督 CatBoost 预测任务标签。

use.en: Compare direct judgments, ordinary text features and frozen semantic features at matched label/inference budgets.
use.zh: 在相同标签／推理预算下比较直接判断、普通文本特征和冻结的语义特征。

caveat.en: Author-reported wine regression. Feature discovery belongs inside development folds; downstream training does not fine-tune Jev or establish financial/multimodal generalization. Separate SeLMRoute text-routing evidence uses grouped protocols; its regret/fallback and omitted extractor cost must not be read as business action safety or complete savings. Not reproduced here.
caveat.zh: 葡萄酒回归属于作者报告；特征发现须限制在开发划分，训练下游模型不等于微调 Jev，也不证明金融／多模态泛化。 独立 SeLMRoute 文本路由证据须按分组协议阅读；其 regret／fallback 与未计提取器的成本不等于业务动作安全或全链路节省，未在此复现。

summary.en: Parallel 23-class scene and 23-class dialogue-intent tasks, official full-SFT baseline, and sourced gold/silver/bronze methods and semifinal scores.
summary.zh: 并列的 23 类场景／23 类对话意图任务、官方 full-SFT 基线，以及有来源的金银铜方法和复赛成绩。

use.en: Study task/label/IO contracts and compare data augmentation, retrieval, adaptation and merging as separate hypotheses; follow the linked case before domain experiments.
use.zh: 研究任务／标签／输入输出契约，将数据增强、检索、适配及合并作为分别检验的假设；领域实验前先看专门案例。

caveat.en: Composite final prizes differ from online F1 ranks. E33 records official semifinal scores; E28 preserves author EcomMIR task results. Pseudo-label exposure and missing exact artifacts limit causal claims, replay and domain transfer.
caveat.zh: 综合最终奖项与线上 F1 排名不同；E33 保存官方复赛成绩，E28 保留 EcomMIR 作者分任务结果。伪标签接触与精确产物缺失限制归因、重放和跨域结论。

summary.en: Inspectable per-question candidate CE+Brier, replay and temperature fitting on a Qwen3.5 text-training path.
summary.zh: 可检查的逐题候选 CE＋Brier、回放及温度拟合，训练路径使用 Qwen3.5 文本输入。

use.en: Study a bounded training/readout baseline before implementing a matched multimodal candidate scorer.
use.zh: 实现同骨干多模态候选评分前，研究有明确边界的训练／读出基线。

caveat.en: Not an image fine-tuning implementation. MIT covers code only; some training data are non-commercial or lack stated terms. No training or calibration result reproduced here.
caveat.zh: 不是图像微调实现；MIT 仅覆盖代码，部分训练数据为非商业许可或未说明条款；未在此复现训练或校准。

summary.en: Text-state teacher/simulator labels train a small option-distribution LoRA student.
summary.zh: 用文本状态的教师／模拟器标签训练小型候选分布 LoRA 学生。

use.en: Inspect distillation inputs and retain both domain and generic regression sets.
use.zh: 检查蒸馏输入，保留领域任务及通用能力回归集。

caveat.en: Game-specific author reports include lost generality. Not image-training or customer-support transfer evidence; complete data/evaluated artifacts not audited.
caveat.zh: 游戏专项作者报告同时存在通用能力下降；不证明图像训练或客服泛化，完整数据／评测产物未审计。

entries.name: StartLux-Decision v1.1 (Instant / AutoThink)

summary.en: Option-letter LM readout: Instant uses prompt-bidirectional full-attention; causal AutoThink conditionally reasons and fuses two distributions.
summary.zh: 使用 LM 选项字母读出：Instant 的 full-attention 提示双向，因果 AutoThink 按需推理并混合两次分布。

use.en: Compare one-pass versus selective computation on evidence-complete decisions, at matched risk and complete cost; commercial use requires separate weight authorization.
use.zh: 在证据充分的判断上以相同风险与总成本比较一次读出和选择性计算；商业使用权重需另获授权。

caveat.en: Public DI is development-selected, not the full/private board. DecisionPivot is author-built/evaluated. Gate 0.9 paper results do not describe current 0.6 defaults; confidence/none signals need policy-specific validation. November 20 targeted review: the October 16 DI lead is historical; DI 0.4.1 changes tasks/weights and no longer places this release first. Neither an aggregate rank nor commercial authorization establishes domain post-training superiority.
caveat.zh: 公共 DI 参与开发选择，并非完整／私有榜；DecisionPivot 为作者自建自测。论文 0.9 门槛成绩不代表当前 0.6 默认；confidence／none 须按实际策略验证。 11月20日定向复核：10月16日DI榜首为历史结果，DI0.4.1改变任务／权重后已非第一；汇总排名或取得商业授权都不证明领域后训练最优。

scale.en: Five Instant nominal sizes: 0.8B/2B/4B/9B/27B; AutoThink: 4B/9B/27B. Cards separately pinned; no independent tensor count.
scale.zh: Instant 五个名义规模：0.8B／2B／4B／9B／27B；AutoThink 为 4B／9B／27B。各卡固定版本，未独立统计张量。

mechanism.en: No new classifier head: selected existing LM A–Z rows, up to 26 candidates/readout; longer lists use group/final tournaments. Each question is a separate row. Instant changes full-attention only; linear-attention layers stay causal. AutoThink keeps causal attention, gates on max(P), and normally fuses 25% initial + 75% post-thought. API confidence is a different statistic.
mechanism.zh: 不新增分类头：选已有 LM 的 A–Z 行，每次最多 26 候选，长列表分组／决赛归约；每题独立 row。Instant 仅改 full-attention，linear-attention 保持因果；AutoThink 全因果，以 max(P) 开门，通常初判 25%＋后判 75%；API confidence 是不同统计量。

training.en: Paper: full-language SFT; merged adapters/data/attention specialization and Instant seed-weight averaging; causal reasoning supervision then RLCD². Vision frozen. RLCD² uses a frozen starting scorer, proper-score difference and soft length penalty with group-relative policy gradients. Public inference plus archived v1 text LoRA does not establish the complete v1.1 training/data package. V2 specifies about 2.7M stage-1 examples for 0.8–9B but 0.8M for 27B; its policy-aware calibration is not a universal per-type temperature guarantee.
training.zh: 论文：语言全参数 SFT；adapter／数据／注意力适配后合并，Instant 多种子权重平均；因果推理监督后接 RLCD²，视觉冻结。RLCD² 由冻结起始评分器计算 proper-score 差值及软长度惩罚，以 group-relative policy gradients 优化推理；公开推理加归档 v1 文本 LoRA 不等于完整 v1.1 训练／数据包。 v2的Stage1约270万只适用于0.8–9B，27B约80万；其策略感知校准也不是单一按题型温度的普遍保证。

availability.en: Inspected vLLM/llama.cpp/MLX/Transformers paths, not executed. Accuracy release vLLM 0.19.1 is text-only; launcher 0.31 enables up to 8 images, video=0. Default Instant context cap 131072; causal configuration 262144, not verified full-context quality. AutoThink default gate 0.6/budget 4096, loop handling and 4000-character tail; full latency includes reasoning and reread. Oct17 fixes normalize list-form criteria/options before tournament routing (including a 26-choice none slot); optional vLLM extra now pins 0.31.0. Eight card revisions are unchanged; no new measured gain. Prism now also serves v1.1 Instant 4B/9B/27B (Q8_0/W4A8), with a complete prompt per question and no shared evidence/prefix cache; thoughts are rejected for Instant. AutoThink uses a separate causal shared-state path; allow_none defaults on. Oct27 fixes MXFP4 double-added residuals that made answers batch-dependent. Internal batch invariance, BF16 parity and probability calibration are separate checks; quantization calibration proves none of the latter.
availability.zh: 已阅 vLLM／llama.cpp／MLX／Transformers 路径，未运行。成绩发布用 vLLM 0.19.1 仅文本；launcher 0.31 最多八图、video=0。默认 Instant 上限 131072，因果配置 262144，不等于全长度质量验证。AutoThink 默认门槛 0.6／预算 4096，含循环处理及末 4000 字符后读；总延迟须含推理与再读出。 10 月 17 日修复将列表式 criteria／options 先规范化再做分组归约，含 26 选项另加 none 的情况；可选 vLLM 依赖现固定 0.31.0。八卡 revision 未变，无新增实测增益。 Prism 现也支持 v1.1 Instant 4B／9B／27B（Q8_0／W4A8）：每题完整 prompt，不共享证据／前缀缓存，拒绝生成 thoughts。AutoThink 另走因果共享状态路径，allow_none 默认开启。10 月27日修复 MXFP4 重复残差导致答案随批次变化的问题；内部批次不变性、BF16 等价、概率校准须分别核验，量化校准不证明后两者。

entries.license_note: Inference code Apache-2.0; all eight inspected v1.1 cards declare CC BY-NC 4.0 weights. Commercial use requires a separate license. Training/reference dataset and backbone terms remain separate; no unrestricted open-source model claim. Prism own code has no selected license at reviewed revision; do not extend the Apache license of vendored files to it.

summary.en: 13 generated contrast families, programmatic labels and public generator/solver/scoring assets; separate reused-public-task reference track.
summary.zh: 13 个生成对比家族、程序标签及公开生成／求解／评分资产，另有复用公共任务参考轨。

use.en: Test response to answer-changing details, pair correctness and selective behavior; pin dataset version and system/run mapping.
use.zh: 测试答案关键细节敏感性、成对正确与选择性行为，固定数据版本和系统／运行映射。

caveat.en: StartLux-author benchmark and runs, not third-party reproduction. Corrected v1.1 and intermediate tables must not be silently equated to the paper release scores. Hindsight coverage metrics are not deployment risk guarantees.
caveat.zh: StartLux 作者自建与运行，不是第三方复现。修正版 v1.1 及中间检查点表不能静默等同论文最终成绩；事后覆盖指标不是部署风险保证。

summary.en: Hosted-and-open decision-model index; v2 (Nov8) scores 50×(1+accuracy−Brier), so calibration enters the headline number, and moves 45% of items to private data.
summary.zh: 托管与开放决策模型指数；11月8日 v2 以 50×(1+准确率−Brier) 计分，把校准计入主分，私有数据占比升至 45%。

use.en: Compare task coverage, label mapping and aggregation alongside the separate HF-hosted index; review per-task outcomes before selecting a model.
use.zh: 与独立的 HF 托管指数并列核对任务覆盖、标签映射及聚合；选型前查看分任务结果。

caveat.en: v1.0 and v2 are different indices; do not compare scores across versions. The reported v2 top three sit within one point, so rank order is not a selection signal. Leaderboard table and per-task results not audited here.
caveat.zh: v1.0 与 v2 是不同指数，分数不可跨版比较。v2 前三名相差在 1 分内，名次本身不构成选型信号；本仓未审计完整榜单与分任务结果。

entries.name: Calibration and Risk-Budgeted Decisions with System One Models

summary.en: Preprint separates probability calibration from fixed-sequence LTT certification of a binary decision policy under a risk budget.
summary.zh: 预印本将概率校准与固定序列 LTT 对二元风险预算策略的认证分开。

use.en: Define score polarity, conditional risk, fallback and Fit/Cal/Test independence before selecting a threshold family; use as a method candidate with explicit assumptions.
use.zh: 选择阈值族前定义分数方向、条件风险、回退及 Fit／Cal／Test 独立性，作为假设明确的方法候选。

caveat.en: Author-reported six English-text datasets, single seed. The iid same-population guarantee is over calibration samples certifying population FOR, not per-item correctness, arbitrary multiclass/VLM risk or distribution shift. No certificate means policy fallback.
caveat.zh: 作者报告六个英文文本数据集、单种子。同分布 iid 保证针对校准抽样认证总体 FOR，不是逐题正确、多类／VLM 任意风险或分布漂移保证；无证书意味着策略回退。

entries.name: Baseten mammoth-1 / elephant-1 / joey-1

summary.en: Qwen-based 27B / 9B / 2B typed-decision family using shared-prefix evidence and separate question readouts; Joey is the smaller October sibling.
summary.zh: 基于Qwen的27B／9B／2B类型化判断系列，共享证据前缀、分别读问题；Joey是10月新增的小型号。

use.en: Matched independent-question comparisons across 2B / 9B / 27B, keeping public-suite and replicated-index evaluations separate.
use.zh: 在2B／9B／27B之间做同合同独立问题对照，将公共suite与复制指数评测分开。

caveat.en: Author public scores and a replica of Artificial Analysis are not official private Full results. Card image-input support does not establish image supervision or production risk. No universal-winner or 48 GB training-fit claim.
caveat.zh: 作者公共成绩及Artificial Analysis复制评测不等于官方private Full；卡片支持图像输入不证明图像监督或生产风险控制，不声称通用胜出或48GB训练可行。

scale.en: mammoth-1 nominal 27B from Qwen3.5-27B, elephant-1 9B from Qwen3.5-9B, Joey-1 2B from Qwen3.5-2B; no local tensor count.
scale.zh: mammoth-1名义27B基于Qwen3.5-27B，elephant-1 9B基于Qwen3.5-9B，Joey-1 2B基于Qwen3.5-2B；未本地统计张量。

mechanism.en: Existing LM answer-code logits with shared-state prefix and separated question suffixes. Full-attention layers use block-bidirectional masks; Gated DeltaNet remains causal. Bounded choice/noul/score outputs require the released prompt/runtime contract.
mechanism.zh: 使用LM答码logits，共享state前缀、问题后缀分开；full-attention用分块双向mask，Gated DeltaNet保持因果。有界choice／noul／score须匹配发布prompt／runtime合同。

training.en: Report/cards describe full language-model fine-tuning with frozen vision and CE plus Brier on a 6.21M-row Mix8; Joey card states one epoch and 16 H100s. Original report and earlier cards conflict on image supervision, so do not certify complete image-training provenance. Recipe disclosure and Brier training are not an audited enterprise fine-tuning package or deployment calibration.
training.zh: 报告／卡描述冻结视觉、全语言微调，以CE加Brier训练621万行Mix8；Joey卡称一epoch、16张H100。原报告与早期卡在图像监督上有冲突，不认证完整图像训练谱系。披露配方及Brier训练不等于已审计企业续训包或部署校准。

availability.en: Public HF serving bundles. Joey binary uploaded October 27; October 29 card links launch. Its trained length is 16,384 and longer requests reject rather than truncate. Public benchmark recipe selection and gated/missing training data still limit reproduction. No verified M5 training workflow.
availability.zh: 公开HF服务包；Joey binary于10月27日上传，10月29日卡链接launch。训练长度16384，超长拒绝而非截断；公共基准参与配方选择及gated／缺失训练数据仍限制复现，未验证M5训练链。

entries.license_note: Reviewed mammoth/elephant/Joey cards declare MIT; check each base, dataset and runtime term. No blanket public-data or commercial-service assurance.

entries.name: Jeffan (31B-1710 / 4B-2010 / 9B and 27B-1211)

summary.en: Text decision releases with distinct compute policies: older Gemma 31B selective rereading and newer Qwen 9B / 27B bidirectional code-readout models with optional layer loops.
summary.zh: 文本判断发布物采用不同计算策略：较早Gemma31B选择性重读，较新Qwen9B／27B为双向答码读出并可循环中层。

use.en: Compare bounded text decisions at fixed loop/reread policies and full request cost, then validate domain/language transfer separately.
use.zh: 固定loop／重读策略及完整请求成本比较有界文本判断，再单独验证领域／语言迁移。

caveat.en: New public-suite scores are author runs, not official private Full. New cards report weaker non-English/unfamiliar-task behavior. Do not transfer old 31B results, thresholds or calibration to new 9B/27B, or treat a passing serving path as a post-training result.
caveat.zh: 新公共suite成绩由作者运行，不是官方private Full；新卡披露非英语／陌生任务较弱。不可把旧31B成绩、阈值或校准移给新9B／27B，也不可把服务可运行当后训练效果。

scale.en: Older Gemma 4-31B and 4B sibling; new Qwen3.5-9B card counts 8.95B and Qwen3.8-27B counts 26.90B, text-only. Layer-loop passes change compute without adding parameters.
scale.zh: 较早有Gemma4-31B及4B型号；新Qwen3.5-9B卡统计8.95B、Qwen3.8-27B统计26.90B，均仅文本。Layer-loop次数改变计算，不新增参数。

mechanism.en: Older 31B rereads the whole input below top probability 0.9 and replaces the first distribution. New 9B / 27B use noncausal full-attention with causal DeltaNet and code logits; repeated middle-layer blocks use damped updates. New 27B default loop_passes=1, new 9B default=2; one-pass vLLM and multi-pass reference are different workloads.
mechanism.zh: 旧31B在最高概率低于0.9时重读整段输入并替换初判；新9B／27B用非因果full-attention、因果DeltaNet及答码logits，以阻尼更新重复部分中层。新27B默认loop_passes=1，新9B默认=2；单pass vLLM与多pass参考是不同负载。

training.en: The new fixed cards identify bases and release weights but do not establish a full original training dataset/recipe or a domain fine-tuning workflow. Rereading and layer loops are inference policies, not training disclosures; no verified production probability calibration.
training.zh: 新固定卡给出base及发布权重，但未建立完整原始训练数据／配方或领域续训链。重读和layer-loop是推理策略，不是训练披露；概率未验证生产校准。

availability.en: New 9B / 27B binaries uploaded November 9; later November 12/13 edits concern card/vLLM serving. Published wrappers support different loop/backend settings; keep exact prompts and total latency. Quantized/GGUF siblings are inference artifacts, not M5 training evidence. Historical 31B context boundaries and unsupported image use remain version-specific.
availability.zh: 新9B／27B binary于11月9日上传；11月12／13日改动主要是卡及vLLM服务。发布封装支持的loop／后端配置不同，须固定prompt并计完整延迟。量化／GGUF sibling是推理产物，不是M5训练证据；旧31B上下文边界及未用图像应限于其版本。

entries.license_note: Reviewed current cards declare Apache-2.0 for weights/inference; earlier 31B / 4B license-only edits remain dated history. Verify exact upstream base terms and any new artifact separately.

summary.en: Calibration-selected cost-aware ticket routing separates probability calibration from error discrimination.
summary.zh: 按校准集选成本敏感工单路由，分开概率校准和错误区分能力。

use.en: Evaluate abstention under stated error/review costs with supervised baselines, frozen selection and common test items.
use.zh: 在明确错误／复核成本下，以监督基线、冻结选择及同一测试样本评估拒答。

caveat.en: One corpus/random split, unequal taxonomy supervision and historical endpoints. Correct fixed-cost human triage is an assumption; reported costs omit full inference/review expense. External frozen archive not accessed.
caveat.zh: 单语料随机划分，类别监督信息不对等、端点较旧。人工分流总正确且成本固定是设定；报告成本未含完整推理／复核费用，未读取外部冻结档案。

entries.name: Commit or Abstain? Missing Legal Authority

summary.en: Third-party provider comparison exposes wrong acceptance versus unnecessary abstention on constructed CaseHOLD.
summary.zh: 独立于模型提供商的评估，在构造 CaseHOLD 上揭示错误接受与不必要拒答的权衡。

use.en: Use an explicit absent-correct-option test and measure both false commitment and false abstention.
use.zh: 显式构造正确选项缺失测试，同时测错误承诺和误拒答。

caveat.en: One English legal task, synthetic absence, public-text training exposure unresolved. Logged API evaluation is not local reproduction; billed call comparisons omit human-review cost.
caveat.zh: 单一英文法律任务、构造性缺失，公共文本训练暴露未排除；API 日志评估不等于本仓库复现，调用费用对比不含人工复核成本。

summary.en: Inspectable image-supervised routes: official QwenVL, ms-swift Qwen3.5, and pinned MLX-VLM image-conditioned language adapters for Mac experiments.
summary.zh: 可查图像监督路径：QwenVL 官方、ms-swift Qwen3.5，以及供 Mac 实验的固定 MLX-VLM 图像条件语言 adapter。

use.en: Compare a gated native Qwen3.5-4B main candidate with matched frozen/head/short-label QLoRA baselines; 2B is a conditional cost control/fallback, not a proven business winner.
use.zh: 以过门槛的原生 Qwen3.5-4B 主候选比较同条件冻结／head／短标签 QLoRA；2B 是条件成本对照／回退，不是已证业务赢家。

caveat.en: Frameworks/checkpoints differ; no local model run or business gain. mlx-decision rejects image training, while mlx-vlm has a separate visual path. Code licenses and per-artifact rights differ; capacity, gradients, masks and reload/export parity remain gates. Community 4B conversion lacks an explicit license/card in the inspected snapshot; trace upstream notices/provenance. Jev-Decision is a Qwen3-VL-2B image-training code precedent, without a public checkpoint/result found in the inspected tree.
caveat.zh: 框架／检查点不同，未本地运行模型或证明业务收益。mlx-decision 训练拒收图片，mlx-vlm 另有视觉路径；代码与产物权利分别核，容量、梯度、mask 及重载／导出等价仍须过关。 所阅社区 4B 转换快照缺显式许可／模型卡，须追溯上游通知和来源。Jev-Decision 是 Qwen3-VL-2B 图像训练代码先例，已阅树未见公开 checkpoint／结果。

summary.en: Evidence-gap annotation and answerability-to-action alignment; newly cataloged Sep26 preprint.
summary.zh: 证据缺口标注及可答性到动作的对齐；本次新收录 9 月 26 日预印本。

use.en: Separate intent, sufficiency and next-action supervision; compare an explicit sufficiency gate with generated abstention.
use.zh: 分开意图、充分性及下一步监督；比较显式充分性门控与生成式拒答。

caveat.en: A-Acc is action agreement, not answer correctness. Model judges/balanced splits limit transfer; code/data availability and reuse rights remain unverified. No local reproduction.
caveat.zh: A-Acc 是动作一致率而非答案正确率；模型裁判／平衡划分限制外推，代码数据可得性和复用许可未核实，未本地复现。

summary.en: Oct22 method uses matched original/image/text/joint controls and checks that mutations preserve the expected answer.
summary.zh: 10 月 22 日方法以原始／仅改图／仅改文／联合四格对照，核查扰动是否保持预期答案。

use.en: Audit joint failures separately from single-modality errors; retain natural conflicts and relabel evidence-changing edits.
use.zh: 将联合失效与单模态错误分开审计；保留自然冲突，对改变证据的编辑重标。

caveat.en: Seed-correct diagnostic selection is not traffic risk. MIT code needs assets, settings, adapters and annotation; paper/code oracle paths differ. No failure counts reproduced here.
caveat.zh: 仅种子答对的诊断选择不是流量风险；MIT 代码仍需资产、设置、适配与标注，论文／代码裁判路径有差异，本仓库未复现失效计数。

summary.en: Same-candidate relevance ranking and held-out probability calibration.
summary.zh: 同候选相关性排序与留出集概率校准。

use.en: Choose evidence-set cutoffs after target-task calibration.
use.zh: 经目标任务校准后选择证据集合截断点。

caveat.en: Third-party paper report; historical Jev1.13 endpoint, judged-pair selection and truncated inputs. No production RAG outcome or local reproduction.
caveat.zh: 第三方论文报告；历史Jev1.13端点、仅已判定样本及截断输入。无生产RAG效果或本地复现。

summary.en: Audits distribution-derived confidence, bundled questions and perturbation explanations.
summary.zh: 审计分布派生置信度、多题干扰及扰动解释。

use.en: Test isolated/bundled parity and retained-label perturbations before deployment.
use.zh: 部署前测试单题／多题一致性与保标签扰动。

caveat.en: Open-weight models, not hosted Jev; quantized single-GPU runs, synthetic clinical cases and balanced security samples. No clinical or security deployment proof.
caveat.zh: 评估开放权重模型而非托管Jev；单GPU量化、合成临床案例与平衡安全样本。不证明临床或安全生产效用。

entries.name: Decision models for RAG conflict typing

summary.en: Flat conflict classification, decomposition and confidence-gated cascades.
summary.zh: 直接冲突分类、问题拆分与置信门控级联。

use.en: Compare direct choice with decomposition and measure downstream grounded answers.
use.zh: 比较直接选择与拆分，并测下游答案证据支撑。

caveat.en: One gateway census; small skewed benchmark, mutable endpoints and model judges. Not statistically equivalent to a stronger LLM or a factual-grounding result.
caveat.zh: 单网关盘点；小型偏斜测试集、可变端点及模型裁判。未证明与强LLM统计等价或事实支撑提升。

summary.en: Zero-shot record-pair matching with prompt, robustness and cascade comparisons.
summary.zh: 零样本记录对匹配，比较提示、鲁棒性与级联。

use.en: Test catalog deduplication after blocking with false-merge costs.
use.zh: 在候选阻塞后测试目录去重，计入错误合并代价。

caveat.en: Paper benchmark evidence; pair classification is not end-to-end entity resolution or proven production savings. Cascade adds an LLM ensemble.
caveat.zh: 论文基准证据；记录对分类不是端到端实体消歧或已证生产节省，级联另加LLM集成。

summary.en: Evaluates serialized sequences, event types and directional predictions.
summary.zh: 评估序列输入、事件类别及方向预测。

use.en: Keep specialized temporal baselines and explicit negative findings.
use.zh: 保留专用时序基线及明确负面结果。

caveat.en: Historical Jev1.13 study; many numerical tasks and stock movement show weak discrimination. No trading return, industrial deployment or local reproduction.
caveat.zh: 历史Jev1.13研究；许多数值任务与股价方向区分弱。无交易收益、工业部署或本地复现。

entries.name: Confidence Is Not a Promise / Typed Deciders Audit

summary.en: Reference audit separates confidence ordering, selective-accuracy promises and their failure under shift.
summary.zh: 参考审计区分置信排序、选择性准确率承诺及其在分布变化下的失效。

use.en: Compare threshold rules with coverage and violation accounting; requalify on the actual language/domain/noise.
use.zh: 同时比较阈值规则的覆盖率与违约率，在实际语言／领域／噪声上重新验证。

caveat.en: Empirical-population tests are not production guarantees. Mostly MASSIVE with five options; near-duplicate training exposure unresolved, hosted snapshots unknown and some Jev raw outputs withheld.
caveat.zh: 经验总体测试不等于生产保证；主要为五选项MASSIVE，近重复训练暴露未排除，托管快照未知且部分Jev原始输出未公开。

summary.en: Paired native-baseline systems study audits resident acceleration, exposed answers and external arrivals separately.
summary.zh: 配对原生基线系统研究，分别审计驻留加速、对外答案字段与外部到达流量。

use.en: Test whether replay/projection/batching preserves the confidence policy consumed by an application, alongside tail latency and failures.
use.zh: 评估回放／投影／批处理是否保持应用使用的置信阈值策略，并测尾延迟与失败。

caveat.en: Four selected checkpoints; short resident gains reverse under diverse traffic. Clef confidence drifts; Liquid ties released compilation. No billed savings, production certification or reproduction here.
caveat.zh: 四个选定检查点；短驻留加速在多样流量下反转，Clef置信漂移，Liquid与发布版编译基本持平。未测账单节省、未认证生产可用且未复现。

summary.en: Supervised item choice with candidate-isolated shared-prefix attention and separately calibrated recommendation confidence.
summary.zh: 监督式商品选择，以候选隔离共享前缀注意力和单独校准的置信度进行推荐。

use.en: Compare direct candidate scoring and confidence-guided computation on fixed histories and candidate budgets.
use.zh: 在固定历史与候选预算下比较直接候选打分及置信引导计算。

caveat.en: Author evaluation with sampled negatives, overlapping histories and possible pretraining exposure; next observed item is not online utility. Cascade cost is an estimate excluding routing overhead; code not audited.
caveat.zh: 作者评估使用抽样负例，跨划分历史未去重且可能有预训练暴露；下一次观测交互不等于线上效益。级联成本为不含路由开销的估算，未审计代码。

summary.en: Pinned CX engine implementation batches per-rule propositions over shared state and resolves declared rule relationships.
summary.zh: 已核CX引擎源码：共享状态批量判断逐规则命题，再解析声明的规则关系。

use.en: Read discovery vs current-turn evaluation, decision ports, code predicates, precedence/exclusion and tool-result reevaluation as separate contracts.
use.zh: 研读候选发现、当轮判断、decision接口、代码谓词、优先/排斥和工具后重判的职责边界。

caveat.en: Retained as code reference, not a production recommendation. The 0.5 lean-yes filter is relevance, not eligibility; native verdicts lack domain unknown/conflict states. Local response decoding needs stricter validation and request failure does not transparently switch to a generator. No full-engine/model reproduction.
caveat.zh: 保留为源码参考，非生产采用建议。0.5偏yes过滤测相关性而非执行资格，原生缺少领域未知/冲突状态；局部响应解码需严格校验，请求失败不透明切换generator；未复现完整引擎/模型效果。

summary.en: Implementer-described product gates event-triggered agent runs with exact filters and a semantic condition.
summary.zh: 实施者产品案例：精确过滤与语义条件控制事件是否启动完整Agent。

use.en: Reference for bounded event-only prechecks before expensive downstream work.
use.zh: 参考在昂贵后续流程前，对事件自身可判条件做有界预检。

caveat.en: No core server source or full effectiveness protocol found. Nov19 docs still start an agent for history/external-data conditions and do not identify a current fast-model build; Oct23 Jev announcement is not a universal current-version claim or a demonstrated production saving.
caveat.zh: 未定位核心服务端代码或完整效果协议；11月19日文档对历史/外部信息条件仍启动Agent，也未固定当前fast模型版本；10月23日Jev公告不能外推为通用现行实现或已验证生产节省。

summary.en: Implementer-reported labeled decisions and replay of historical customer-routing decisions.
summary.zh: 实施者报告的标注决策与真实客服历史路由回放。

use.en: Separate message disposition, specialist routing, missing state, conflicting rules and fallback effects.
use.zh: 分别检查消息处置、专员路由、状态缺失、规则冲突和回退效果。

caveat.en: Retain as a report and negative lessons, not a reproducible code project. Public business APIs do not expose the evaluation harness; complete labels/per-row outputs were not located. Offline replay and constructed-case accuracy do not establish production or Chinese-service benefit.
caveat.zh: 保留报告与反例，非可复算源码项目；公开业务API不是评测harness，未定位完整标签/逐条输出；离线回放和构造测试准确率不证明生产或中文客服收益。

entries.name: SII-Decision (4B / 27B)

summary.en: Reasoning-to-readout self-distillation into non-generative typed decisions; open 4B and 27B releases.
summary.zh: 将推理后概率自蒸馏为零生成类型化判断；公开4B与27B产物。

use.en: Capability and distillation comparator; evaluate exact released checkpoints separately from enterprise adaptation.
use.zh: 作为能力与蒸馏参照；发布检查点评测与企业领域适配分别验证。

caveat.en: JEVal is reported by SII authors. Required teacher/reference/gold fields and original-base training configurations are not a generic released-checkpoint hard-label warm-start recipe. No matched Chinese enterprise or Mac training result here.
caveat.zh: JEVal包含作者对自有SII的报告。教师／参考／gold字段及从原始底座开始的配置，不等于从发布检查点直接硬标签续训。这里无共同中文企业数据或Mac训练实测。

scale.en: 4B: Qwen3.5-4B; 27B LoRA/Full: Qwen3.8-27B.
scale.zh: 4B基于Qwen3.5-4B；27B LoRA／Full基于Qwen3.8-27B。

mechanism.en: Candidate probabilities at a fixed first-answer-token readout without a generated rationale at deployment.
mechanism.zh: 部署不生成推理，在固定首个答案token位置读出候选概率。

training.en: Average two same-size reasoning-teacher distributions, distill by weighted soft cross-entropy, ordinal expected-score penalty and KL to p0. Released loader requires gold_target, train_target and p0; gold also controls hard-Noul weighting. LoRA and language-linear full tuning are distinct; Full still freezes embeddings/output head/norm/vision.
training.zh: 平均同规模教师两次推理分布，以加权软交叉熵、序数期望差惩罚及对p0的KL蒸馏。公开loader要求gold_target、train_target与p0；gold还控制hard-Noul权重。LoRA与语言linear层Full训练分开；Full仍冻结embedding／输出头／norm／vision。

availability.en: Public standalone BF16 HF releases and code. LoRA training saves adapters; published LoRA releases merge them into BF16 weights. Full training saves separate standalone checkpoints. Current multi-GPU launchers and inference demonstrations do not establish M5 training. The family has multiple HF revisions.
availability.zh: 公开独立BF16 HF产物与源码。LoRA训练保存adapter，发布LoRA是合并后的BF16权重；Full训练保存独立完整检查点。当前多GPU启动器及推理演示不能证明M5训练可行；系列有多个HF revision。

entries.license_note: Repository/model cards declare Apache-2.0; retain upstream model and dataset obligations. No local tensor download or authentication of paper-evaluated weights.

summary.en: Multidomain English/Chinese evaluation of local typed decisions, reasoning limits and workflow composition.
summary.zh: 面向中英文多领域的局部类型化判断、推理边界与工作流组合评测。

use.en: Check comparable task-level metrics and failure modes before task-specific acceptance.
use.zh: 在具体任务验收前检查同协议指标与失败类型。

caveat.en: SII authors evaluate their own model; 10938 classification accuracy and valid-only calibration differ in denominator. Pooled benchmark results are not Chinese enterprise production proof or an all-version ranking.
caveat.zh: SII作者评测自有模型；10938分类准确率与仅valid输出的校准指标分母不同。汇总基准不是中文企业生产证明，也不是跨版本总榜。

summary.en: Proper-score optimization of each sampled rationale’s answer distribution for selective prediction.
summary.zh: 为选择性预测优化每条采样推理之后的答案分布，以恰当评分规则为目标。

use.en: Compare with matched generative SFT/GRPO plus calibration when production retains reasoning and accepts or defers on the resulting distribution.
use.zh: 生产保留推理、按其后概率接受或转交时，与匹配的生成式SFT／GRPO加校准比较。

caveat.en: A method/code artifact, not TypeSafe RLCD disclosure or a no-generation model release. Accuracy and ranking can trade off; public code alone does not establish full paper reproduction or Mac feasibility.
caveat.zh: 这是方法／代码产物，不是TypeSafe RLCD披露或零生成模型发布。准确率与排序可权衡；公开源码不证明论文完全复现或Mac可行。

summary.en: Evidence-guided and self-critique teacher labeling, followed by separate domain/intent/issue RoBERTa classifiers for real ecommerce conversations.
summary.zh: 以证据解释和自检改善教师标签，再为真实电商对话训练独立的领域／意图／问题RoBERTa分类器。

use.en: Study enterprise label quality, multi-turn state and supervised low-latency routing; keep labeler audit, classifier evaluation and online outcomes separate.
use.zh: 研究企业标注质量、多轮状态与低延迟监督路由；区分教师审计、分类评测和线上结果。

caveat.en: Author-reported production A/B lacks sample/allocation/interval details and changes several system factors. Private data are unavailable; deployed classifier is not evidence that the offline LLM hybrid or soft-distribution distillation caused the online gain.
caveat.zh: 作者生产A/B未披露样本／分配／区间，系统同时改变多项因素；原数据私有。部署分类器不证明离线LLM级联或软分布蒸馏导致了线上收益。

summary.en: Adjacent typed extraction/estimation family: November 18 redesign uses parallel slot autoregressive extraction plus specialized numerical heads, separate from Clef closed-option decisions.
summary.zh: 相邻的类型化提取／估计系列：11月18日改版用并行slot自回归提取及专用数值头，与Clef闭集判断分开。

use.en: Study extraction of business facts before downstream decisions, with field completeness, evidence grounding and total latency measured.
use.zh: 研究下游判断前的业务事实提取，验收字段完整性、证据定位及完整延迟。

caveat.en: Input-only pricing does not mean zero generation. Official results are internal author evaluations; no complete enterprise fine-tuning package or M5 run was established. The released 27B / 9B cards declare Apache-2.0, but open weights do not prove production confidence calibration.
caveat.zh: 只按输入计费不等于零生成；官方结果为内部作者评测，未建立完整企业续训包或M5运行证据。发布27B／9B卡声明Apache-2.0，但公开权重不证明生产置信度已校准。

entries.name: GLiDE / Fastino

summary.en: Five-size open-weight decision family plus a native customer training API.
summary.zh: 五尺寸开放权重判断系列，并有面向客户数据的原生训练API。

scale.en: 0.4B / 0.8B / 2B / 9B / 27B; inspect each backbone/readout separately.
scale.zh: 0.4B／0.8B／2B／9B／27B；各尺寸骨干与读出分别核验。

mechanism.en: Typed closed-option readout. The fixed public 2B runtime reports top1-minus-top2 confidence; score is the argmax level, with expectation in expected_level. Larger variants add recurrent depth.
mechanism.zh: 类型化闭集读出。固定公开2B运行库的confidence为top1与top2概率差；score为最高概率档，期望另在expected_level；大尺寸另有循环深度。

training.en: Native text rows accept gold and/or soft_target; glide_decision combines CE/KL (.3/.7 by default). A specific training/deploy API exists; complete public local trainer not located. Small-model prices and a 2B demo exist, but exact self-service IDs/account access/export remain untested.
training.zh: 原生文本行接受gold及／或soft_target，glide_decision默认组合CE／KL(.3／.7)。已有具体训练／部署API，未定位完整公开本地trainer；有小模型报价及2B示例，但精确自助ID、账号开放性及导出未实调。

availability.en: Family announced Nov5; fine-tuning example Nov18. Five public HF sizes; reviewed cloud training is text-only, 16,384 tokens/row, 512 rows/batch and no lora_config. No M5 backward or local training validation.
availability.zh: 11月5日发布家族、18日有微调示例；五个HF尺寸公开。所核云训练仅文本，每行16,384 tokens、每批512行，不接lora_config；未验证M5反向或本地训练。

use.en: Add a small-model/readout comparator and, if data may leave the enterprise, a managed domain-adaptation route.
use.zh: 新增小模型／读出对照；企业数据可获准上云时比较托管领域适配。

caveat.en: Do not inherit thresholds from another System One service. Public weights, a synthetic simulator improvement and training API documentation do not establish Chinese customer-service superiority or five-size self-service support.
caveat.zh: 不能继承其他System One服务阈值；公开权重、合成模拟器增益及训练API文档不确立中文客服优势，也不证明五尺寸均已自助可训。

entries.license_note: Fastino Community License, not Apache; production commercial use by entities above the stated US$10M revenue threshold requires a separate agreement. Backbone terms also apply.

entries.name: Liquid d1 / d1.2

summary.en: Open d1-2B/Omni-2B and separate hosted d1.2/ultra decision products.
summary.zh: 开放d1-2B／Omni-2B与独立托管d1.2／ultra产品。

scale.en: Open d1-2B about1.92B, with text/image/video inputs; Omni-2B is a separate artifact. Hosted ultra scale is not inferred from open2B.
scale.zh: 开放d1-2B约1.92B，支持文本／图像／视频输入；Omni-2B为另一产物。不从开放2B推测托管ultra规模。

mechanism.en: Typed decisions and extraction shapes vary by runtime. Multi-choice reports per-option P(yes), not a normalized single-choice simplex.
mechanism.zh: 类型化判断与提取形状依运行库而异；多选返回各项P(yes)，不是和为1的单选分布。

training.en: Generic LFM fine-tuning tooling is public, but a complete d1-specific typed-head training/save/reload/calibration path was not established.
training.zh: 通用LFM微调工具公开，尚未建立d1专属typed-head训练、保存重载及校准闭环。

availability.en: Hosted d1.2 announced Nov16; open2B replaces old3B. Official MPS/MLX inference and Chinese among16 languages; no user-machine training run.
availability.zh: 托管d1.2于11月16日发布；开放2B替代旧3B。官方有MPS／MLX推理、16语言含中文；无用户目标机训练实测。

use.en: Study a small non-Qwen implementation and multi-label contract; evaluate hosted and local artifacts separately.
use.zh: 研究小型非Qwen实现及多标签合同，托管与本地产物分别比较。

caveat.en: Do not transfer ultra benchmarks to open2B or confuse M5 inference with48GB training. Typed-answer support and reported calibration vary by release/runtime.
caveat.zh: 不能将ultra成绩搬给开放2B，也不能将M5推理当48GB训练；类型与校准声明依版本／运行库而异。

entries.license_note: LFM Open License v1.0; commercial revenue threshold and separate-agreement conditions apply, not unconditional Apache.

entries.name: Mapika Decider

summary.en: Open typed-decision family with supervised training/data builders; previously sourced but missing a core catalog entry.
summary.zh: 有监督训练及数据构造器的开放判断系列；此前已有研读来源，但缺核心索引条目。

scale.en: Reviewed2B v12,4B v3 and31B v2 releases date through Oct20.
scale.zh: 本轮核2B v12、4B v3及31B v2，发布至10月20日。

mechanism.en: Candidate-conditioned Qwen readouts and per-type temperatures; text/image contracts depend on size and release.
mechanism.zh: 候选条件化Qwen读出及按题型温度；文本／图片合同依尺寸与版本。

training.en: Public supervised recipe, data builders and own-label conversion. Environment PPO is a separate reported experiment; its complete research trainer was not located.
training.zh: 监督配方、数据构造及自有标签转换公开；环境PPO为另一报告实验，未定位完整研究trainer。

availability.en: Open weights/code; existing October releases, not newly trained today. MPS/MLX domain training not validated.
availability.zh: 权重／代码公开；属于10月发布补录，非今天新训练；未验证MPS／MLX领域训练。

use.en: Compare an inspectable supervised implementation and its per-type calibration; study environment learning only with matching feedback.
use.zh: 比较可审查的监督实现与逐题型校准；反馈匹配时才研究环境学习。

caveat.en: Default Noul T=.05 targets score optimization, not a validated probability. Fitted-temperature alternatives and all mixed-source licenses need separate review.
caveat.zh: 默认Noul T=.05用于分数优化，不代表概率已校准；拟合温度替代项与混合来源许可分别核验。

entries.license_note: Apache-2.0 project/model declarations; upstream and mixed training-source conditions remain separate.

entries.name: RSI-Jev v7.0-VL

summary.en: Open Qwen decision implementation with public full training code and a truncated3B derivative.
summary.zh: 公开完整训练代码的Qwen判断实现，另有截断3B衍生物。

scale.en: 4B instruction backbone;3B is the first20 language layers without retraining.
scale.zh: 4B指令底座；3B由前20语言层截断，未另训。

mechanism.en: Option-echo token pooling, bidirectional prefix and detached early-exit heads.
mechanism.zh: 候选复述的token pooling、双向前缀及分离梯度的早退头。

training.en: Full language fine-tuning with soft CE, retention/permutation KL and ranking; train/v7.0 and recipe public. Original2.76M rows/traces/dev not released; reported run used4 H200s.
training.zh: 语言全参训练，含soft CE、保留／排列KL及排序；train/v7.0及配方公开。原276万行／轨迹／dev未发布；作者运行用4张H200。

availability.en: 4B weights Nov5, truncated3B Nov7, MLX4bit conversion Nov10; fixed CUDA/NCCL trainer, MLX inference is separate. No M5 training receipt.
availability.zh: 4B权重11月5日、截断3B于7日、MLX4bit转换于10日；trainer固定CUDA／NCCL，MLX为推理；无M5训练回执。

use.en: Prioritize code inspection and a small own-label comparison, including simple readout/LoRA controls.
use.zh: 优先审实现并做小规模自有标签对照，保留简单读出／LoRA基线。

caveat.en: Public code is not full original-data reproduction; 3B/quantized variants are not independent training gains. Author benchmarks do not establish target-domain superiority.
caveat.zh: 源码公开不等于原数据完整复现；截断／量化不是独立训练增益，作者成绩不确立目标域优势。

entries.license_note: Apache-2.0 declarations; inspect exact backbone, data and runtime dependencies before deployment.

entries.name: Jeff 1.1 / j-geuter

summary.en: Open decision training implementation, distinct from Jeffan; published weights/data have noncommercial restrictions.
summary.zh: 与Jeffan不同的公开判断训练实现；发布权重／数据有非商用限制。

scale.en: Qwen4B/27B and Gemma12B/31B variants; complete4B weights existed by the reviewed Oct23 snapshot and are unchanged through Nov14.
scale.zh: Qwen4B／27B及Gemma12B／31B；所核10月23日快照已有完整4B权重，至11月14日tensor未变。

mechanism.en: Residual LM-row head with rank32 LoRA and three-seed adapter/head soup.
mechanism.zh: 残差LM-row读出，rank32 LoRA及三seed adapter／head平均。

training.en: Trainer/export, four configs and --data own JSONL were published Nov14; soft CE. DecisionBank mixes annotator votes and a Qwen teacher, including on annotator rows.
training.zh: 11月14日公开trainer／export、四配置及--data自有JSONL；用soft CE。DecisionBank结合标注票数与Qwen教师，含有人类票数的行也混教师。

availability.en: Code and raw dataset inspectable; current trainer selects CUDA/CPU, not native MPS. Existing4B tensors did not change with new trainer publication.
availability.zh: 源码及原始数据可审；当前trainer选择CUDA／CPU，无原生MPS路径；新公开trainer没有改变既有4B tensor。

use.en: Study data/training mechanics; for commercial use train an appropriately licensed base on authorized own data.
use.zh: 参考数据／训练机制；商用应从许可合适底座与获授权自有数据起训。

caveat.en: Published weights and full mixed dataset cannot be assumed commercially reusable. No Chinese-enterprise adaptation or M5 training evidence; do not conflate this owner with Jeffan.
caveat.zh: 不能默认发布权重及全量混合数据可商用；无中文企业适配或M5训练证据，不能与Jeffan混同。

entries.license_note: Published weights CC-BY-NC-4.0; full mixed DecisionBank explicitly noncommercial. Code, base and individual data licenses are separate.

entries.name: JAD-S1 v0.5

summary.en: Diffusion/MoE-based closed-option decision adapter with single-mask readout.
summary.zh: 基于扩散／MoE、单mask读出的闭集判断adapter。

scale.en: LLaDA-MoE7B total /1B active; resident memory is not1B.
scale.zh: LLaDA-MoE总7B／激活1B，驻留内存不等于1B。

mechanism.en: Read candidate-letter logits at one masked position rather than autoregressive answer generation.
mechanism.zh: 在单个mask位置读取候选字母logit，不自回归生成答案。

training.en: Rank8 adapter and inference/calibration package public; no complete trainer or raw training corpus in inspected release tree.
training.zh: rank8 adapter及推理／校准包公开；所审发布树无完整trainer或原始训练语料。

availability.en: v0.5 adapter uploaded Nov12 UTC, card version Nov13. Author ROCm128GB environment; not a validated M5 training path.
availability.zh: v0.5 adapter于UTC11月12日上传、卡标13日；作者用ROCm／128GB环境，非已验证M5训练路径。

use.en: A different-backbone/readout research control if the local task justifies it.
use.zh: 任务有需要时作为不同骨干／读出的研究对照。

caveat.en: Author Chinese translations/benchmarks are not enterprise data; active parameter count and open adapter do not establish low-memory training.
caveat.zh: 作者中文翻译／基准非企业数据；激活参数与开放adapter不确立低内存训练。

entries.license_note: Apache-2.0 declarations for base/adapter code; exact dependencies and data rights remain separate.

entries.name: H2O Lightning 4B

summary.en: Open Qwen4B typed-decision engine; this is a catch-up inclusion, not a November20 weight release.
summary.zh: 开放Qwen4B类型化判断引擎；属于补录，非11月20日新权重。

scale.en: Qwen3.5-4B; reviewed package v1.2.2.
scale.zh: Qwen3.5-4B；所核包v1.2.2。

mechanism.en: Custom typed readout/attention; option-order averaging, two-way reading and calculator settings change the measured path.
mechanism.zh: 定制类型读出／注意力；候选顺序平均、双向重读及计算器配置改变实际测量路径。

training.en: Training descriptions do not establish a complete own-data training/save/reload loop in this release.
training.zh: 训练描述尚未建立本发布物的完整自有数据训练／保存重载链。

availability.en: Created Oct2, current snapshot Nov1; image-capable inference package, no M5 backward verification.
availability.zh: 10月2日创建、当前快照11月1日；有图片推理包，无M5反向验证。

use.en: Small typed-inference comparator after protocol and prompt settings are fixed.
use.zh: 固定协议／提示配置后作为小型类型化推理对照。

caveat.en: Do not use stale October leaderboard placement as current quality or mistake HF auto-generated chat examples for the typed API.
caveat.zh: 不能用10月旧榜位代表当前质量，也不能把HF自动聊天示例当类型化API。

entries.license_note: Apache-2.0 card declaration; check exact upstream/runtime licenses.

entries.name: MNN-Pocket-0.3B-Dec

summary.en: Small Chinese/English choice, proposition and ordinal pointer-head package.
summary.zh: 小型中英Choice／命题／有序评分pointer-head发布包。

scale.en: About300M base plus rank16 adapter and pointer head; bundled base is about723MB.
scale.zh: 约300M底座加rank16 adapter及pointer head；包内底座约723MB。

mechanism.en: Escaped reserved markers, shared state and isolated question branches; up to255 options with32k request rejection boundary.
mechanism.zh: 转义保留marker、共享state并隔离问题分支；最多255选项，32k请求边界超长拒绝。

training.en: Unmerged adapter/head present; inspected bundle exposes inference/calibration, not a complete domain-training loop.
training.zh: 有未合并adapter／head；所审包提供推理／校准，非完整领域训练loop。

availability.en: Created Oct15; metadata current Nov10. Original quantized/mobile MNN formats are separate artifacts; M5 training untested.
availability.zh: 10月15日创建、元数据至11月10日；原移动量化MNN格式为不同产物，M5训练未测。

use.en: Very small Chinese readout/cost control, paired with a trained multilingual encoder.
use.zh: 极小中文读出／成本对照，同时保留已训多语encoder。

caveat.en: Reported temperature fit on600 calibration cases is not held-out task accuracy or an enterprise risk guarantee.
caveat.zh: 600个校准样本的温度拟合不等于独立任务准确率或企业风险保证。

entries.license_note: Apache-2.0 LICENSE.txt declaration; upstream terms remain applicable.

entries.name: IBM Granite Switch / decision adapter

summary.en: A reusable decision adapter alongside chat, guard and ASR capabilities on Granite4.1.
summary.zh: Granite4.1上可复用的decision adapter，与聊天、guard及ASR并列。

scale.en: Frozen8B/30B base plus rank64 adapters; tiny adapter does not remove the resident base.
scale.zh: 冻结8B／30B底座加rank64 adapter；小adapter不消除底座驻留。

mechanism.en: LoRA/aLoRA decision marker activates single-label-token logits; no sampling/generate for decisions. Each question uses a pass; aLoRA reuses pre-marker base cache.
mechanism.zh: LoRA／aLoRA判断marker激活单标签token读出；判断不采样／generate，每题一次pass，aLoRA复用marker前底座cache。

training.en: Adapter artifacts and inference contract public; generic PEFT adaptation is not a verified complete decision-domain training pipeline. aLoRA is not merged into the base.
training.zh: adapter产物及推理合同公开；通用PEFT可适配不等于完整判断领域trainer已验证；aLoRA不合入base。

availability.en: Official introduction Oct15; current core/adapter revision Oct28, v1.1. English card; no M5 training validation.
availability.zh: 官方10月15日介绍；当前core／adapter于28日、v1.1；卡为英语，无M5训练验证。

use.en: Study decision/chat sharing and cache-aware adapters when a larger resident base is justified.
use.zh: 较大底座确有必要时，研究判断／聊天共用及cache-aware adapter。

caveat.en: Adapter size and cache sharing are efficiency mechanisms, not calibrated correctness or Chinese adaptation evidence.
caveat.zh: adapter大小与cache共享是效率机制，不是概率校准或中文适配证据。

entries.license_note: Apache-2.0 declarations; base, adapter and dependencies must be pinned separately.

entries.name: Ant Digital LingDT-Decision-1.0

summary.en: Hosted typed decision service with native question-dependency DAG.
summary.zh: 托管类型化判断服务，原生支持问题依赖DAG。

scale.en: Current public contract identifies a4B test endpoint; no public weight identity established.
scale.zh: 当前公开合同列4B测试端点，未建立公开权重身份。

mechanism.en: Choice, multi-choice, proposition, score and extraction. The native depth3 DAG service calls layers sequentially and injects upstream_answers into later state; this is orchestration, not established single-forward model dependency reasoning.
mechanism.zh: 单／多选、命题、评分与提取。原生深度3 DAG服务逐层调用，并将upstream_answers注入后续state；这是编排合同，不证明模型单前向完成依赖推理。

training.en: No public weights or this decision product-specific customer fine-tuning entry verified.
training.zh: 未核公开权重或本判断产品专属客户微调入口。

availability.en: Observed free test-period contract:4B endpoint,16k request,32 questions,255 options, default60RPM. A production reference to LingDT1.1 does not identify a new Decision1.1 checkpoint.
availability.zh: 本次观察免费测试期合同：4B端点、16k请求、32题、255选项、默认60RPM；建议生产用LingDT1.1不等于确立新Decision1.1检查点。

use.en: Domestic hosted contract/dependency reference; evaluate access and data governance separately.
use.zh: 国内托管合同／依赖参考，另验访问与数据治理。

caveat.en: Public service metadata establishes an advertised contract, not actual account availability, self-training or production effect.
caveat.zh: 公开服务元数据只确立声明的合同，不证明账号可用、自主后训练或生产效果。

entries.license_note: Proprietary service terms; no open-weight or customer training license established.

entries.name: Respan Span-02

summary.en: Open decision serving artifact with a specialized quantized Rust/CUDA engine and optional reasoning.
summary.zh: 使用专用量化Rust／CUDA引擎、可选推理的开放判断服务产物。

scale.en: Gemma4 26B-A4B; about4B active is not4B resident or trainable-package memory.
scale.zh: Gemma4 26B-A4B；约4B激活不等于4B驻留或训练包内存。

mechanism.en: Choice is non-generative readout; number questions generate numeric tokens. auto/on/off and budget_ms change the returned decision path.
mechanism.zh: Choice为非生成读出，number题生成数字token；auto／on／off及budget_ms改变实际判断路径。

training.en: No full trainer, raw training data or trainable BF16 release established; current engine is an inference artifact.
training.zh: 未建立完整trainer、原始训练数据或可训练BF16发布物；现有engine为推理产物。

availability.en: Blog Oct15, gateway changelog Oct19. Specific NVIDIA engine, about28GB GPU memory; not ordinary Transformers/vLLM or a verified M5 route.
availability.zh: 博客10月15日、gateway于19日更新；专用NVIDIA引擎、约28GB GPU内存，非普通Transformers／vLLM或已验证M5路线。

use.en: Study self-hosted inference and budgeted reasoning as separate serving controls.
use.zh: 研究自托管推理与预算推理，作为独立服务策略对照。

caveat.en: Span-01 behavior detection is a different contract. Quantized open serving weights do not establish enterprise post-training or portable confidence thresholds.
caveat.zh: Span-01行为检测为另一合同；开放量化服务权重不确立企业后训练或可移植置信阈值。

entries.license_note: Apache-2.0/Gemma4 declarations; inspect engine and upstream terms separately.

entries.name: Decisio tuned v3 / Tachara AI

summary.en: November20 Gemma12B tuned release with calibrated and commit serving policies and multiple precision ports.
summary.zh: 11月20日发布的Gemma12B适配权重，含calibrated／commit策略及多精度部署包。

scale.en: 12B; about22GB merged BF16 weights, not total training memory.
scale.zh: 12B；合并BF16约22GB，仅权重、非完整训练内存。

mechanism.en: One forward per question reads typed-option probabilities; per-type temperature and an external calculator affect the service.
mechanism.zh: 每题一次前向读取类型化选项概率；逐题型温度及外部计算器影响服务。

training.en: Card reports rank32/alpha64 LoRA on463,859 questions for one epoch. Inspected server tree does not establish a complete public own-data trainer; card calibration claims need independent task validation.
training.zh: 卡称rank32／alpha64 LoRA、463,859题一epoch；所审服务树未建立完整公开自有数据trainer，卡的校准声明须独立任务验证。

availability.en: Eight November20 repos include policy/FP8/MLX variants. Complete declared LFS tensor sets match between the two BF16 flavors; no tensor bytes downloaded. MLX inference is not MLX training.
availability.zh: 11月20日八个仓包含策略／FP8／MLX变体；两BF16策略包完整声明LFS tensor集合相同，未下载tensor字节；MLX推理不等于训练。

use.en: A fresh serving/readout comparator; evaluate calibrated policy, commit policy and calculator under the same contract.
use.zh: 新增服务／读出对照；同合同分验calibrated、commit及计算器。

caveat.en: Author held-out tests come from its training distribution, not an independent enterprise benchmark. Policy variants are not eight separately trained models; calibration is not guaranteed under shift.
caveat.zh: 作者留出测试来自其训练分布，非独立企业基准；策略变体不是八个独立训练模型，漂移下不保证校准。

entries.license_note: Apache-2.0 card/LICENSE declaration; base, runtime and derived artifacts separately pinned.

entries.name: Valen-Decision1.5
entries.license_note: Apache-2.0 native model/code declarations; original training data not public, upstream and media/data rights remain separate.

summary.en: Multimodal typed-decision family with native published-checkpoint domain training, separate from its ONNX/GGUF/ANE conversions.
summary.zh: 多模态类型化判断系列，有从已发布native检查点领域训练的入口，与ONNX／GGUF／ANE转换分开。

scale.en: Fixed4B audit; family card lists0.8B/2B/4B/9B/27B. BF16 backbone and FP32 decision/grounding heads.
scale.zh: 固定核4B；家族卡列0.8B／2B／4B／9B／27B；BF16骨干、FP32判断／grounding头。

mechanism.en: Block-bidirectional attention, trained Mixer and bbox grounding; typed predicate/choice/score/bbox readout, with shared-state question branches.
mechanism.zh: block-bidirectional注意力、已训练Mixer及bbox grounding；predicate／choice／score／bbox类型化读出，shared-state问题分支。

training.en: Complete native checkpoint can retain Mixer/grounding for own-JSONL full or LoRA SFT. Public runner, schema/configs, resume/export tests and cookbook; the SFT loss defaults to distribution CE, with optional RPS/Brier used by the domain example. Sampled discrete-action RLCD is a separate experimental objective, not PRDO or a verified TypeSafe recipe. Original training data not public.
training.zh: 完整native检查点可保留Mixer／grounding，用自有JSONL做full／LoRA SFT；公开runner、schema／配置、恢复／导出测试及cookbook。SFT loss缺省为分布CE，领域示例另配可选RPS／Brier；采样离散动作RLCD是另一个实验目标，不是PRDO或已验证TypeSafe配方。原始训练数据未公开。

availability.en: Complete4B tensors uploaded Nov9; Nov12 card edit, Nov15 source snapshot. Official0.8B/H200 one-update plus resume smoke is not a4B/M5 run. Trainer defaults CUDA; configured-device float64 statistics need MPS compatibility work. ANE/ONNX/GGUF are inference formats.
availability.zh: 完整4B tensor于11月9日上传，12日改卡，源码快照15日。官方0.8B／H200单步加恢复smoke不是4B／M5运行。默认CUDA；配置device上的float64统计需处理MPS兼容；ANE／ONNX／GGUF为推理格式。

use.en: Prioritize an inspectable native-checkpoint LoRA comparator for proprietary data on compatible hardware; keep original and direct CE controls.
use.zh: 在兼容硬件上优先纳入可审查的native续训LoRA对照，保留原版及直接CE控制。

caveat.en: Short engineering receipts and author public index results do not establish enterprise adaptation gains, Chinese long-state performance or calibrated acceptance risk. A Metal/ANE port does not solve training device, gradient or export contracts.
caveat.zh: 短工程回执及作者公共指数不确立企业适配增益、中文长状态表现或校准放行风险；Metal／ANE端口不解决训练设备、梯度及导出合同。

entries.name: To Jev or Not to Jev (System-1 models as LLM judges)

summary.en: Pre-registered comparison of 14 System-1 decision models with four generative judges on eleven judge benchmarks, including reference-guided judging, calibration and injected-instruction robustness.
summary.zh: 预先声明协议，在 11 个评审基准上比较 14 个 System-1 决策模型与 4 个生成式评审，覆盖参考答案引导、校准与注入指令鲁棒性。

use.en: Design a cheap first-stage judge with escalation; test injection robustness per model before using it on untrusted outputs.
use.zh: 设计带升级的低成本一级评审；用于不可信输出前逐模型测注入鲁棒性。

caveat.en: Abstract-level review only. Judge benchmarks are public English tasks; injection robustness is model-specific, not a property of the System-1 design.
caveat.zh: 仅摘要级阅读。评审基准为公开英文任务；注入鲁棒性取决于具体模型，不是 System-1 设计的共性。

entries.name: Reading Right, Acting Wrong (agent-loop decision diagnosis)

summary.en: Pairs each agent next-action question with independent factual probes on the same state to separate misreading from wrong action.
summary.zh: 对同一 agent 状态同时提问下一步动作与独立事实探针，区分“读错状态”与“读对仍选错”。

use.en: Add state probes to agent-decision evaluations before attributing failures to the readout or to missing evidence.
use.zh: 把失败归因于读出或证据缺失之前，先在 agent 决策评测中加入状态探针。

caveat.en: Preliminary v1, abstract-level review. Frozen states from simulated and benchmark environments, not live enterprise traffic.
caveat.zh: 初版预印本，仅摘要级阅读。冻结状态来自模拟与基准环境，不是真实企业流量。
